EYP Staff EYP Financial Restructuring Job Description
Support financial restructuring and turnaround advisory business development activities under the guidance of senior team members. Assist with proposal development support including:
Financial analysis of companies - reviews of historical and forecast performance, profitability, cash flows, working capital and capital structure
Support the team in understanding clients businesses, key financial trends, profitdrivers and potential areas of risk or improvement
Conduct desktop market and industry research, gather relevant data and summarize findings into meaningful insights
Assist with benchmarking analyses, including capital and debt mix, working capital levers, revenue trends and product performance
Prepare clear and well-structured Excel analysis, PowerPoint presentations and supporting reports for business development requirements.
Assist in preparing materials for client discussions, internal reviews and pursuit meetings.
Document the analysis and procedures performed, ensuring that work products are accurate, organized and aligned with project objectives.
Coordinate with team members across different service lines and locations to support data collection and timely project delivery.
Contribute ideas, ask relevant questions and work collaboratively with colleagues in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrate attention to detail, adaptability and a willingness to learn while managing assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
This internship provides hands-on exposure to financial restructuring, turnaround, capital advisory and transaction-related projects, supported by structured learning and coaching.
Candidate Profile
Ideal for candidates looking to start their career in finance
Strong academic foundation in finance, accounting and financial statement analysis.
Basic understanding of corporate finance concepts such as cash flow, working capital, debt, capital structure and business performance.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
Good desktop research skills and the ability to identify, organize and summarize relevant market and company information.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in developing financial analysis and presentation skills.
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot in a business setting would be an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, well-structured work.
Proactive, curious and willing to learn new concepts, industries and analytical approaches.
Able to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a project team.
Comfortable working across multiple tasks and adapting to changing project requirements and deadlines.
Prior internship, academic project or coursework in corporate finance, banking, restructuring, transactions or consulting would be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the MENA business environment, banking products or Islamic Finance would be an added advantage.
Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Discipline Clients & Industries
Role Type C&I Business Operations Coordinator
Business unit specific description Clients & Industries GDS Europe West
Join our GDS Clients & Industries and you will help support the important business enablement functions that keep our organization running strong. As an Operations professional, you will work across teams both onshore and offshore to provide the knowledge, resources and tools that help EY deliver exceptional quality service to our clients, win in the marketplace and support EY's growth and profitability.
With so many offerings, you can develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Maintain pipeline hygiene and ensure the accuracy of sales and revenue data.
Support account management activities and stakeholder engagement.
Prepare business reports, forecasts, and performance updates.
Collaborate with teams to resolve data issues and improve reporting quality.
Provide insights to support business reviews, leadership meetings, and client discussions.
Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and digital tools.
Skills and attributes for success
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years work experience in professional services industry.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Experience doing secondary research using Google and other external sources like Factiva, Company Inforgator, BoardEx, OneSource etc
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, preparation of newsletters, managing surveys etc.
Private Equity/Investment Banking Industry experience preferable but not essential.

Description:
Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.

Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Description:
Role Overview
The role involves developing and maintaining relationships with leading architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients, including HNI and UHNI customers.

This is a relationship-driven business development role, rather than a conventional field sales position. The selected candidates will represent a premium brand, identify high-value projects, develop market connections, coordinate client visits, and nurture business opportunities through to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Identify and develop business opportunities in luxury residential projects, villas, hospitality, and premium commercial interiors.
Conduct regular market visits to architect studios, design firms, project sites, and client locations.
Promote MCI's premium collections of natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, and surface solutions.
Generate leads through networking, market mapping, referrals, industry contacts, and architect/designer databases.
Understand project requirements and coordinate with architects and designers to recommend suitable products.
Arrange and coordinate visits to MCI's Experience Centre for architects, designers, and prospective clients, wherever applicable.
Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospects and project stakeholders to convert opportunities into business.
Track enquiries, quotations, samples, project requirements, and lead conversion status.
Develop and maintain an updated database of architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium customers.
Support the development of the assigned market and achievement of business targets.
Maintain disciplined daily and weekly activity reports, lead updates, and follow-up records.
Represent MCI professionally at client meetings, exhibitions, industry events, and design-related networking activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, upcoming projects, and emerging business opportunities.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
Natural stone, marble, granite, and imported stone
Premium tiles, sanitaryware, and surface materials
Luxury furniture, modular kitchens, and premium interiors
Architectural products, high-end lighting, and home automation
Luxury real estate, project sales, and premium construction materials
Other premium product segments involving regular interaction with architects, interior designers, builders, and developers

Experience in natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, or premium surface materials will be an added advantage.
Freshers are also welcome if they demonstrate strong communication skills, confidence, professionalism, a willingness to learn, and an interest in architecture and luxury interiors.

Required Skills & Qualities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Confident, energetic, well-groomed, and professionally presentable.
Strong relationship-building, networking, and negotiation skills.
Genuine interest in luxury interiors, architecture, and premium products.
Ability to engage effectively with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Proactive, self-motivated, and target-oriented approach.
Strong follow-up, lead-management, and reporting discipline.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and travel within the assigned market.
Knowledge of the local market and established industry contacts will be an advantage.
Fluency in English and the relevant local language is essential. Hindi proficiency will be an added advantage.

Salary Range:
- Freshers: 20,000 30,000 per month
- Experienced candidates: 25,000 40,000 per month
Final compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, communication skills, market exposure, relevant industry knowledge, and overall suitability for the role

Interested Candidates
Candidates who are passionate about premium products, relationship management, and business development in the luxury architecture and interior-design segment are encouraged to apply.

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager Operations to manage multiple sites in Facility Management / Integrated Facility Management (IFM).
Key Responsibilities:
Manage end-to-end facility operations across multiple client sites, including housekeeping, technical maintenance, pantry, front office, landscaping, and other facility services.
Ensure service delivery in line with contractual requirements, SLAs, KPIs, and company standards.
Manage client relationships, conduct operational reviews, and resolve client complaints and escalations.
Lead Facility Managers, Assistant Facility Managers, supervisors, technicians, and frontline teams.
Plan manpower deployment, recruitment, training, attendance, and employee performance.
Monitor operational budgets, manpower costs, vendor expenses, and contract profitability.
Ensure statutory compliance, workplace safety, quality standards, and audit readiness.
Manage vendor performance, procurement coordination, and operational resources.
Prepare and review operational MIS reports and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
Support new site mobilization, contract retention, and business growth opportunities.
Educational Qualification:
Graduate or Diploma in Engineering, Facilities Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related field.
MBA or relevant professional certifications will be an added advantage.
Experience:
8–12 years of experience in Facility Management / IFM / Operations.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a managerial or multi-site operations role.
Experience in managing large teams, client relationships, budgets, and service delivery is preferred.
Required Skills:
Multi-site operations management
Client and stakeholder management
Team leadership and manpower planning
Budgeting and cost control
Vendor and contract management
Statutory compliance, safety, and quality management
MIS reporting, problem-solving, and decision-making
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Interested Candidates: Please share your updated CV at Karthik.s@in.issworld.com.

AboutCompany:
ISS is a leading workplace experience and facility management company, provides placemaking solutions that contribute to better business performance and makes life easier, more productive, and enjoyable delivered to high standards by people who care.

As a global company with a heritage of fairness, equality, and inclusion, we empower all our people to deal with problems and opportunities when they arise. We know that when we get things right, it enhances lives and makes the world work better and that is what drives us.

With over 1,000+ clients, managing 180 million square feet of blue-chip facilities, serving over 750k+ meals per day, securing and guarding over 2500 facilities, we have a presence in 150+ cities across 21 States. ISS India is today a significant player in the Facility Management & Professional Services industry in India.

Assists in the management of the daily functions of the department to ensure protection of property assets, employees, guests and property. Maintains logs, certifications and documents required by law and Standard Operating Procedures. Position focuses on ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while achieving the operating budget.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 1 year experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations
- Assists the Director of Engineering in administering fire prevention programs and emergency preparedness.
- Assists in conducting hazard and risk assessments at the property to include quarterly OSHA/SAFETY audits, incident tracking, and the hazard abatement process.
- Assists in the development of detailed "shut down" procedures for the property to ensure that all areas are secured at the appropriate times.
- Complies with applicable federal, state and local law and safety regulations.
- Follows proper key control guidelines in loss prevention and in the property.
- Develops a monthly checklist for all cctv equipment, alarmed doors, and duress alarms to ensure that they are fully functional.
- Incorporates into patrols, which encompass all areas of the propertys interior and exterior, an inspection tour of recording system.
- Follows Duty of Care process for the protection of guests and employees.
- Follows up on all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair the well being of guests and employees.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Implements action plans to monitor and control risk.
- Monitors all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair the well being of guests and employees.
- Oversees all loss prevention operations to include but not limited to patrol process, emergency response, investigations (initial follow up) for all guest and employee related incidents, shipping and receiving process (makes recommendations for improvement), electronic key system and manager on duties responsibilities.
- Oversees and guides the efforts of the Accident Prevention Committee.
- Oversees first aid program for guests and employees.
- Oversees the claims process and protects company assets by closely monitoring the General Liability and Workers Compensation cases.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Meet quality standards and customer expectations on a daily basis.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, developing formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaching or instructing others.
- Inspects and critiques the performance of the loss prevention department to establish and maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

Additional Responsibilities
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Develops liaison with local law enforcement and emergency services.

- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

Description:
As a Technical Superintendent at BSM, you will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical and operational oversight of assigned vessels, ensuring safe, compliant, and cost-efficient ship management. The role plays a critical part in connecting ship and shore by acting as the primary technical point of contact for vessels, clients, and external stakeholders, while supporting BSM s strategic objectives, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement of fleet performance.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver contractual ship management services in line with customer agreements, ensuring vessels meet required technical and operational standards
Act as the primary technical contact for Masters and Chief Engineers, providing guidance on safety, maintenance, drydock planning, critical equipment, and non-routine repairs
Maintain close communication with clients on technical, operational, and budgetary matters, building effective working relationships
Monitor vessel machinery, equipment performance, and maintenance execution to enhance safety, reliability, energy efficiency, and operational performance
Develop, implement, and monitor maintenance, repair, and drydocking plans, ensuring timely execution within approved budgets
Prepare, control, and report technical and OPEX budgets for assigned vessels
Ensure vessels maintain valid certification and comply with all applicable maritime legislation
Plan, conduct, and follow up on vessel visits, inspections, audits, and surveys
Coach, mentor, and support shipboard personnel, including performance reviews, interviews, and contribution to career development
Qualifications Experience
Bachelor s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or equivalent, or a valid Chief Engineer s Certificate
Minimum of three years sailing experience as a senior officer, or three years shore-based experience as a technical superintendent within a ship management or owning company
Sailing or management experience with VLGC vessels is essential
Skills Competencies
Leadership and people management skills with a coaching and mentoring mindset
High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability
Team-oriented, proactive, and safety-focused approach
Fluency in English and solid computer literacy
Why You Should Join Us!
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
On-the-job training.
First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
Diverse workforce.
Technology-driven company.
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family

Responsibilities
Perform end to end discovery of SSH keys, SSL/TLS certificates, and cryptographic assets across hybrid environments.
Analyze key and certificate usage patterns, identify security gaps, and recommend remediation strategies.
Support secure lifecycle management practices for SSH keys and SSL/TLS certificates, including rotation, revocation, and access controls.
Conduct cryptographic discovery within applications, services, and infrastructure to identify cryptographic primitives and algorithms in use.

Strong understanding of cryptographic principles, PKI, SSL/TLS, SSH, and trust models.
Familiarity with Linux/Unix/Windows administration, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and automation.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and native key/certificate services.
Strong communication, analytical, and collaboration skills.

JOB DESCRIPTION
AVIT Meeting Room
Operations L3 Lead
Role Overview
The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
Key Accountabilities
Operational Leadership
Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.
Advanced Incident and Problem Management
Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.
Service Reliability and Monitoring
Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.
Device Lifecycle Operations
Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.
Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management
Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.
Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement
Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.
Technology and Service Environment
Area Indicative Environment
Meeting-room platforms : Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
Operations tooling : ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
Technical domains : Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
Service practices: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
Candidate Profile
Required Experience and Knowledge
Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate - Senior Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Familiar with the latest design trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
Mentor junior team members on best design practices
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Take ownership and work as a design consultant independently
Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
Strong visual design capability
5+ years of relevant experience
Ideally, you ll also have
Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills
Team management experience
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
What we offer
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR

- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.

- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.

- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.

- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate

Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

Job Title- Area Sales Head - CONSUMER LIGHTING
Level-Assistant Manager
Location-Ludhiana

Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Consumer Lighting division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.

3-6 Years
Salary

Best in industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified™ Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
For more details, visit www.havells.com
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
The Marketing Assistant Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Manager of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role assists with building deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Assists with the execution of the annual marketing plan to budget .
- Provides support to Operations, Food Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Works with advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Assists with the management of FB media schedules email marketing and display advertising.
;
- Stays informed about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Helps verify that all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Supports facilitation ofsocial media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Assists with promotions campaign in FB, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Participates in the development of comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency;
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Assists with writing and distribution of all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Supports execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Helps manage external vendors and media agencies; Assists with review of PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for FB advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Assists with photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
May serve as a point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Assists with coordination and execution of Hotel and FB printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Supports the production of all property, FB display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Assists with the execution of FB direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists in the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint FB promotions.
- Works with the Manager of Marketing and Communication to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
-
- Provides marketing assistance and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.
- Performs other reasonable job duties as assigned by manager.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

- Opportunity for career growth within a dynamic and diverse work environment.

- 7 to 10 years of experience in B2B/B2G (lighting division/Building Material only) sales,
- Having MBA or equivalent degree if its B.tech or B.Arch with MBA is preferred.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proven track record in team management.

Rapid response to operational needs through on-demand task execution with minimal turnaround time.

Accurate car inventory management using basic Excel skills to support tracking and reporting.

Reliable and detail-oriented individual with a strong sense of responsibility.
Ability to maintain clean and safe working conditions through hands-on housekeeping and vehicle care.
Good understanding of yard and vehicle management procedures.
Flexibility to handle on-demand tasks efficiently.
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for maintaining car inventory records.
Commitment to maintaining operational standards through regular inspections and task follow-through.

Why Join Us?
Drive key business initiatives and growth.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
Competitive compensation and career.

How to apply?

Fast-track your career to the next level by sending your resume to: deepanshi.1@cars24.com

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments

Role & responsibilities
Project Execution & Delivery
Lead end-to-end execution of new store fit-outs, renovations, relocations, and infrastructure projects.
Ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality parameters.
Develop and implement project execution strategies aligned with expansion plans.
Monitor project progress and proactively resolve execution bottlenecks.
Drive on-time store handovers to operations and business teams.

Construction & Site Management
Oversee construction activities across locations and ensure adherence to approved designs, specifications, and brand standards.
Conduct periodic site reviews and audits to ensure quality standards and execution excellence.
Ensure compliance with all statutory, safety, and regulatory requirements.
Drive implementation of best construction practices and standardization across projects.

Vendor & Contractor Management
Build and manage a strong network of contractors, consultants, architects, and project management agencies.
Monitor contractor performance against quality, cost, and timeline commitments.
Lead commercial negotiations and drive cost efficiencies without compromising quality.
Establish vendor scorecards and periodic performance reviews.

Cost & Capex Management
Own project budgets and CAPEX planning.
Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization.
Drive standardization of materials, finishes, and technologies to improve project economics.
Monitor project financials and ensure budget adherence.

Quality & Compliance
Establish project quality benchmarks and execution standards.
Conduct quality audits and compliance reviews across ongoing and completed projects.
Ensure all projects meet organizational specifications and regulatory requirements.
Drive corrective actions to minimize defects and rework.

Expansion Planning & Stakeholder Management
Partner with Business Development, Operations, Design, Procurement, Finance, and Leadership teams to support expansion plans.
Provide project feasibility inputs during site evaluation and approval stages.
Present project updates, dashboards, and risk assessments to senior leadership.
Drive seamless cross-functional coordination throughout the project lifecycle.

Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing project execution team.
Establish KPIs, governance mechanisms, and project review frameworks.
Foster a culture of accountability, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.

Preferred candidate profile
Demonstrated experience in leading large-scale retail/QSR expansion projects.
Strong understanding of interior fit-outs, civil works, MEP, and finishing materials.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Commercially astute with a strong focus on quality, timelines, and cost optimization.
Capable of influencing senior stakeholders and driving execution through cross-functional teams.

Job Title - Area Sales Head-Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan)
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Amritsar Br.
Reporting To Product head
Supervising- Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan) division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

5-8 Years
Salary

Best In industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach

Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc
