Job Title - GN - SONG - MT - Hyperpersonalization - Analyst

Management Level 11 - Analyst

LocationGurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore

Must have skills Banking, Fintech Industries

Good to have skills Marketing

ExperienceOverall experience of 2+ years with at least 1 year of experience in the Banking/Fintech domains, delivering insights with a focus on designing & executing customer-centric initiatives.


Educational QualificationPost-Graduation (Preferably MBA)

Job

Summary You will work closely with our clients as consulting professionals who design, build and implement initiatives that can help deliver hyper-personalized experiences for their customers and enhance business performance within Banking and Fintech landscape.

Roles & Responsibilities
Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

o Collaborate with various client teams (including marketing, sales, and product) to align customer value management strategies with the respective teams' and overall organization's business goals.

o Communicate effectively with internal ACN leaders, SMEs and teams to ensure a cohesive and client-centric approach.

o Manage relationships with key partners to ensure compliance and smooth execution of all partner-related initiatives.

Data Analysis

o Monitor trends to identify anomalies, promptly flagging them to stakeholders and ensuring follow-up to resolution.

o Analyze data to uncover growth opportunities and recommend potential improvements.

o Track performance metrics and marketing interventions, highlighting key insights and resolving critical issues to support business objectives .

Project Management

o Plan , execute, and oversee projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals.

o Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets, proactively addressing risks and mitigating issues.

o Monitor project performance, report progress to stakeholders, and implement process improvements for efficiency.

Retention / Churn Reduction Strategies

o Design and implement customer retention programs that are aligned to the unique challenges and opportunities of the Banking/Fintech/Insurance sectors to reduce churn and increase customer lifetime value leveraging data and analytical models.

o Work closely with product and marketing teams to create hyper-personalized campaigns and promotions to engage and retain customers.

Cross-Sell and Upsell Initiatives

o Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling based on segment-level behavior and preferences tailored to the banking / e-commerce / retail sectors.

Business Development

o Create business cases, solution deals and develop proposals to bring the best of Accenture's capabilities to clients.

 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Skills:
Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset to drive results-oriented decisions.

In-depth knowledge of industry from banking / fintech.

Strategic Thinking - Capability to align projects and processes with long-term business goals.

Crisis / Risk Management - Ability to effectively manage and lead during crises or challenging project situations by implementing contingency plans

Strong understanding of marketing processes & operating models

Good project management skills – The ability to plan, execute, and oversee projects to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and meeting the specified goals.

Additional skills

o Excellent oral and written communication skills

o Proven success in navigating global matrixed environments and / or experience in client facing roles

o Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, fast-paced & unstructured global environment


Additional Information


An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients


Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.


Ability to embed responsible business into everything"”from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.



Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities


Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Comfort with schedulers (AutoSys/Control-M/Airflow) and shell/Python scripting for batch or chestration; familiarity with secretsmanagement and environment configuration.
Domain understanding of post-trade data flows and how to encode the m into repeatable regression checks.

Department-Sales operations
Location-Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Colombo
Position reports to-Associate Director - Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management
Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to EHS guidelines, statutory compliances, and internal audit requirements.
Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Review & Reporting
Prepare and review Monthly Management Reports (MMR), operational dashboards, and business review presentations.
Track key operational, financial, and customer experience metrics.
Share periodic updates with stakeholders and management on site performance.

Educational Qualification
Any Graduate / BE/ B.Tech/ MBA/ Hospitality courses/ BHM (Any)

Experience
8-17 years of experience in Facility Management, Property Management, Community Management, or Operations.
Experience managing residential townships, premium housing societies, or mixed-use developments preferred.
Prior experience leading multiple sites and vendor management is desirable.

Description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
What you will be doing:
Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.
What we need to see:
Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

Job Details
Position Type: Permanent
Experience: 7-10 Years
Notice Period: Immediate
Work Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad / Gurgaon
Work Type: Work From Office (WFO)

Interview: 2 Rounds Virtual
Laptop: Mandatory for Interview

Role Summary
We are looking for a hands-on SAP ECP / EC Payroll QA Test Analyst to execute testing for US Payroll implementations on the SAP Employee Central Payroll (ECP) platform.
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of US Payroll processing, hands-on experience with EC-to-ECP integration testing, and the ability to accurately execute payroll test scenarios and scripts within a structured testing environment.

Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in the Payroll domain, preferably with SAP HCM Payroll and/or SAP ECP / EC Payroll.
Mandatory US Payroll experience, including:
US tax processing
Wage types
BSI TaxFactory
Garnishments
Retro processing
Year-end processing including W-2
2+ years of hands-on experience in Integration Testing / SIT execution on SAP HCM or ECP programs.
Experience testing payroll interfaces such as ACH/NACHA bank files, GL, time integration, and third-party vendor feeds.

Key Technical Skills
SAP ECP / EC Payroll – payroll schema/PCR familiarity, wage type catalog, payroll control record, and payroll log analysis.
SuccessFactors Employee Central – understanding of EC-to-ECP replication, compensation, organizational and position data flows.
US Payroll – federal, state and local taxes, BSI TaxFactory, garnishments, off-cycle and retro processing, W-2.
Integration testing across:
EC-to-ECP
Payroll-to-GL
Payroll-to-Bank
Time-to-Payroll
Experience with parallel payroll runs and variance comparison between legacy payroll systems and ECP.
Defect management using HP ALM / Quality Center, JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.

Key Responsibilities
Execute test cases and scripts across SIT, parallel testing, UAT and regression cycles.
Execute payroll scenarios covering gross-to-net calculations, federal/state/local tax withholding, garnishments, off-cycle payroll and retro processing.
Perform EC-to-ECP integration testing and validate employee master data, compensation, organization and position data flows.
Test payroll interfaces including ACH/NACHA bank files, GL postings, time & attendance feeds and third-party integrations.
Support payroll parallel runs, perform result comparisons, document variances and assist with root-cause analysis.
Validate US payroll tax scenarios and BSI TaxFactory results.
Execute year-end scenarios including W-2 and W-2c validation, where applicable.
Log and track defects with complete payroll-specific details including wage types, pay periods, employee populations and replication steps.
Review test scripts, identify coverage gaps and provide execution status to the test lead.

Soft Skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in test execution.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify payroll variances.
Clear and structured defect reporting.
Ability to work within defined testing schedules and proactively escalate blockers.

Good to Have
Multi-state US Payroll experience, including state reciprocity and local taxes.
Experience with ADP, Ceridian, or other legacy payroll systems.
Previous consulting / SI delivery project experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile
SAP ECP / EC Payroll + US Payroll + QA Testing + SIT + Integration Testing + Payroll Interfaces + Parallel Run + BSI TaxFactory

Job Details

Job Type: Full Time


Key Responsibilities

Conduct operational data collection as required by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compile security operational reports.
Establish data hygiene processes to guarantee security data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with corporate privacy standards.
Design, build, and maintain real-time automated operational dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Track key performance indicators (KPIs) across Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT) deployments, equipment readiness, and incident response times.
Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual security operational reports analyzing security trends, site-level risks, and resource utilization across locations.
Perform variance analysis comparing actual deployments and equipment costs against maximum Statement of Work (Scope of Services) caps and monthly baseline targets.

Experience handling operational data streams, incident log analysis, or physical security metrics
Strong knowledge of data governance principles, data hygiene practices, and corporate privacy compliance standards.

We're Nagarro, we are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. REQUIREMENT:
We are hiring experience in quality gates and testing standards across development sprints.
Review business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
Develop end-to-end test scenarios and detailed test cases.
Design positive, negative, boundary, and exception test scenarios.
Define representative test data and validation criteria.
Functional & Business Validation
Validate business workflows and AI-generated outputs against expected business logic.
Ensure KPI calculations, mathematical computations, and business rules are accurately implemented.
Partner with the BA team to validate domain-specific scenarios while maintaining an independent QA perspective.
AI & Agentic Testing
Validate AI-generated responses for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and relevance.
Test agentic workflows across multi-step execution paths.
Validate prompt execution, orchestration, context propagation, and exception handling.
Identify hallucinations, reasoning failures, and workflow inconsistencies where applicable.
Performance & Non-functional Testing
Plan and coordinate performance and scalability testing.
Execute concurrent user testing using approved enterprise tools (e.g., JMeter).
Validate response time, throughput, and resource utilization.
Coordinate integration and regression testing.
Defect Management
Manage the defect lifecycle from identification through resolution and re-validation.
Track quality metrics and report testing progress.
Prepare SIT summary reports and release readiness assessments.
Automation
Identify regression candidates for automation.
Define and maintain the automated regression suite.
Improve testing efficiency through reusable test assets.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Writing and reviewing great quality code
Understanding functional requirements thoroughly and analysing the clients needs in the context of the project
Envisioning the overall solution for defined functional and non-functional requirements, and being able to define technologies, patterns and frameworks to realize it
Determining and implementing design methodologies and tool sets
Enabling application development by coordinating requirements, schedules, and activities.
Being able to lead/support UAT and production roll outs
Creating, understanding and validating WBS and estimated effort for given module/task, and being able to justify it
Addressing issues promptly, responding positively to setbacks and challenges with a mindset of continuous improvement
Giving constructive feedback to the team members and setting clear expectations.
Helping the team in troubleshooting and resolving of complex bugs
Coming up with solutions to any issue that is raised during code/design review and being able to justify the decision taken
Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead IT Infra Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-
We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India

Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Role Summary
Responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, AWS cloud platforms, network security and IT operations, while ensuring effective IT procurement, vendor coordination and billing management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Microsoft 365 & SharePoint
Manage Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, SSO, Active Directory and Azure integrations.
Develop and maintain SharePoint customizations, SPFx/React JS applications and Power Platform solutions.
Manage Microsoft 365 security policies using Defender and Intune.
Troubleshoot Office 365, email, network, firewall and cloud service issues.
2. Infrastructure & Cloud
Manage DNS, email routing, Azure services, web applications, APIs and storage.
Deploy and manage AWS services, instances, AMIs and SaaS infrastructure.
Configure and optimize AWS, Azure and internal cloud environments.
Implement automation, patching, backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Monitor cloud usage, capacity, performance and costs.
3. Network & Security
Manage enterprise network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, IPS, proxy, web/email filtering and next-generation security solutions.
Configure firewall policies, authentication services, load balancers and SD-WAN.
Maintain knowledge of MPLS, BGP, OSPF, TACACS and related network technologies.
Identify, investigate and resolve major incidents and security vulnerabilities.
4. Identity, Endpoint & IT Support
Manage Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, ADFS and Hybrid Exchange.
Implement SSO, MFA, access controls and endpoint security.
Manage BYOD, ActiveSync and mobile device support.
Provide technical support, problem management and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Drive ITSM, SLA adherence and service improvement.
5. IT Procurement & Vendor Management
Coordinate IT procurement for hardware, software, cloud services, licenses and infrastructure.
Raise and track purchase requisitions, POs, quotations and delivery schedules.
Coordinate with vendors, Procurement, Finance and internal teams for timely delivery.
Maintain records of contracts, licenses, warranties, renewals and IT assets.
Support vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations and cost optimization.
6. IT Billing & Cost Control
Validate vendor invoices against POs, contracts, SOWs and agreed rates.
Verify quantities, taxes, rental charges, licenses, cloud consumption and discounts.
Track recurring IT bills, AMC, connectivity, cloud and managed services.
Resolve billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections, credit notes and adjustments.
Maintain billing trackers and support monthly cost reconciliation and budget reporting.
7. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and asset details.
Follow IT security, change management, audit and compliance requirements.
Ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities, audit observations and operational issues.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field.
8-12 years of experience in M365, cloud infrastructure, network security and IT operations.
Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Active Directory, Exchange, networking and security technologies.
Proficiency in PowerShell and infrastructure automation.
Experience in IT procurement, vendor management and invoice validation.
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Job Description
This role is part of the Marketing function and is responsible for driving strategy, market development, commercialization, and lifecycle management across assigned products and therapeutic areas. The Marketing team partners closely with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustainable business results through customer-focused strategies.
This position is based in Gurgaon, India and operates in a Flex work model, combining on-site and remote work based on business needs. Travel of approximately 35-40% is expected to support customer engagement, market development activities, internal collaboration, and business initiatives across regions.
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing product, portfolio, and market strategies that drive commercial growth and customer impact. This individual will translate customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable strategies, lead commercialization initiatives, and influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. The role requires strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and accountability from opportunity identification through execution.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute product, portfolio, and market strategies aligned with commercial and business objectives.
Analyse customer, market, competitive, and business data to identify growth opportunities, unmet needs, and emerging market trends.
Lead product planning, commercialization, launch execution, market development, and lifecycle management 
initiatives.
Define customer segmentation, product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies to improve market performance.
Partner with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional teams to deliver strategic priorities.
Monitor business performance, evaluate return on investment, and optimise marketing programmes, resource allocation, and investments.
Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies to build alignment, support decision-making, and drive execution of key initiatives.
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and resources to ensure successful delivery of high-impact programmes.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline and 10+ years of experience in marketing, product management, commercial strategy, market development, or related commercial roles; MBA from a premier business school required.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing product, portfolio, or commercial strategies that delivered measurable business results.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Strong analytical capability with experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business insights into strategic recommendations.
Experience managing commercialization, product launch, market development, or lifecycle management activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within MedTech, healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, biotechnology, or life sciences industries.
Experience leading regional or multi-country marketing initiatives and influencing stakeholders across geographies.
People leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or managing marketing professionals.
Experience with portfolio optimisation, market access strategies, and customer engagement planning.
Advanced proficiency in business analytics, forecasting, market assessment, and strategic planning methodologies.

Virtual Engagement Solutions (Remote Sales) is focused on expanding customer reach, increasing engagement with existing and prospective accounts, and driving commercial growth through remote customer interactions. VES partners with sales leaders across multiple Medtronic Operating Units to identify opportunities, support market development initiatives, and improve access to Medtronic therapies through a scalable virtual engagement model.
This role leads remote sales activities across the North, East, and West regions of India, supporting a broad portfolio of businesses and customer segments. The position is preferably based in Gurugram, with Mumbai also considered, and operates in a primarily office-based environment where virtual engagement is the primary mode of customer and stakeholder interaction. Travel is expected up to 25% for business reviews, team engagement activities, customer meetings, and key stakeholder interactions.
The Remote Sales Supervisor will lead the expansion and execution of the Virtual Engagement Solutions (VES) model across North, East, and West India. This role combines people leadership, strategic account management, pipeline oversight, business development, and cross-functional collaboration to drive commercial growth through remote sales channels. The position is responsible for building team capability, supporting market expansion, and delivering commercial objectives across multiple Operating Units.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of 6-7 remote sales representatives to deliver annual operating plan objectives across assigned regions.
Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, driving engagement, opportunity development, and commercial outcomes through virtual interactions.
Partner with commercial leaders and stakeholders across multiple Operating Units to identify growth opportunities and execute market development initiatives.
Expand Medtronic's presence within new and underserved accounts through targeted remote engagement strategies and customer outreach programmes.
Monitor sales pipelines, account targeting activities, opportunity progression, forecasting, and reporting to maximise commercial performance.
Coach and develop direct reports through performance management, capability building, and sales effectiveness initiatives.
Analyse sales performance data, market trends, and customer insights to identify opportunities for revenue growth, market share expansion, and process improvement.
Lead planning, coordination, reporting, and implementation of VES projects and operational initiatives across supported businesses.

Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of team management, product marketing, sales leadership, or commercial management experience.

Preferred:
Experience within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or related healthcare industry.
Experience managing inside sales, remote sales, contact centre, virtual sales, or customer engagement teams.
3+ years of people management experience leading, coaching, and developing teams of 6-7 or more direct reports.
Experience supporting multiple business units, product portfolios, or matrixed commercial organisations.
Knowledge of account development, market expansion, customer engagement strategies, and data-driven sales performance management across diverse geographic regions.

Description:
Lead - Business Development

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Utilize internal tools and adhere to company guidelines to deliver efficient and high-
quality service.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer
satisfaction.

Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.

Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding

Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.

At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.

AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Description:
About Us: Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.

Our Leaders: Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.
Summary of the Role: We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.

Responsibilities:
Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals

Required Skills and Qualifications:
Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)

What's in it for You?
Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures. Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 1218 months.
Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Description:
The opportunity
Were looking for candidates with experience in carrying out routine substantive and controls-based assurance testing for the engagement teams during the financial year end for the Europe or US region.
Your key responsibilities
•Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific review procedures as defined by the engagement teams
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential review issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the immediate supervisor  
Collaborate with seniors and engagement teams to set goals and responsibilities  
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards  
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the team members 
Maintain a strong client focus, be responsive to team requests, and develop/maintain productive working relationships with team contacts  
Where appropriate, challenge procedures used in the past by team members and attempt to enhance review techniques
Compare efficiency of review procedures performed across different clients and suggest ideas for improvement.
Contribute ideas/opinions to the assurance teams and listen/respond to other team members' views
Use technology to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery  
Promote EY’s ethical and professional standards, including data confidentiality, especially when dealing with outsiders
•• Skills and attributes for success
• Confident and outgoing individual with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to meet tight deadlines and ensure that work is of a consistently high standard
• Ability to multi-task, pay attention to detail, prioritize projects and follow up on routine
 tasks diligently
 Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping,  
• Ability to communicate with leaders and peers with ease
• Plan ahead and anticipate potential issues before they arise
 Good written and oral communication skills
 Ability to work effectively in a team
To qualify for the role, you must have
Candidates who are ACCA Affiliate or Part qualified (9 papers and above) OR CA qualified / CA Inter with Articleship completed OR CPA semi qualified.
6 months to 1 year of relevant work experience preferred.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Interest in business and commerciality.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Be a Part of a Growing Team.
Be a Part of Jamco Interiors!
Jamco is a premier global provider of aircraft interiors, holding market-leading positions in lavatories and galleys, a growing presence in business/first-class seating, and associated modification services. With more than 2,000 employees globally, Jamco combines decades of experience with advanced manufacturing and engineering expertise to create cabin products and services that elevate passenger experience, enhance operator efficiency, and set new standards in durability and design.

Are you a talented Technical Publication/Technical Writing Expert with 0-5 years of experience looking for an exciting career opportunity.If you're interested, click the Apply button and review the Job Description (JD) and Walk-in Interview details below.

The Technical Writer develops and performs advanced technical writing tasks associated with manuals and data using established design data, standards, and internal procedures. Provides guidance, training, and technical support.

Responsibilities:• Create, revise, and maintain various manuals like CMM & IPC in compliance with industry standards iSpec2200 and S1000D.• Develop illustrations to support documentation.• Perform tasks independently at a high level across all product lines.• Evaluate and revise manuals, write department procedures, and maintain indexes.• Resolve complex technical problems and provide guidance to team members.• Participate in project meetings and translate contract requirements into work requirements.

Qualifications:• Strong knowledge of engineering science and technology for maintenance manuals.• Familiarity with FAA & EASA requirements, aircraft fundamentals, and industry standards.• Proficient in creating and revising various documents and data.• Advanced mathematical and language skills.• Exceptional problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities.• Proficient in using CAD systems, Microsoft Office, and relevant software tools.• Excellent communication and presentation skills.• Degree in technical discipline and 0 to 5 years of experience in aerospace.• Experience in authoring iSpec2200 and S1000D standards.• Proficient users of FrameMaker, QuarkXPress, IsoDraw, Adobe Illustrator, Lattice XVL, Word, Excel, and Eagle Publishing System.

General Requirements:• Ability to manage time efficiently and work under pressure.• Strong understanding of industry quality control standards.• Exceptional ability to research, analyze, and create technical data.• Positive attitude, attention to detail, and ability to work in a team environment.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

Specific vision abilities required, including close and color vision.• This position is fully office-based and is not a remote or hybrid role. Must be willing and able to work from the office five days per week.• Accurate reporting of time worked.
• Continuous skill improvement and professionalism.

Communication:• Effective communication in writing and orally.

Job Location: Pune or Bangalore Only

Important Notes:
Candidates who have attended an interview with Jamco within the last 1-1.5years are requested not to apply
Only candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be considered for the selection process

Take the next step in your career journey with Jamco. We look forward to connecting you!

Description:
HIRING: RELATIONSHIP MANAGER

Start Your Career with NoBroker.com!
Company: NoBroker.com
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Experience: Freshers Welcome
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Work From Office

About NoBroker
NoBroker.com is India's leading brokerage-free property platform, connecting property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers directly. We aim to simplify real estate transactions by providing convenient, transparent, and technology-driven property solutions

Job Overview
We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target-oriented individuals to join our team as Customer Relationship Managers. The role involves interacting with customers, understanding their requirements, explaining relevant NoBroker services, managing leads, and driving sales conversions through effective communication.

Key Responsibilities
Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in finding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers. Keep customers up-to-date on the progress of his account.
Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Go extra mile to provide excellent customer service
Eligibility Criteria
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of regional languages is an advantage.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a customer-focused mindset.
Ability to work in a target-driven sales environment.
Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply
Working Schedule & Job Details
Shift Timing: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
Login Time: 9 hours per day
Daily Talk-Time Target: 4 hours
Working Days: 6 days per week
Weekly Off: 1 rotational day off per week
Work Mode: Work From Office
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Brief Summary
The Executive at ORRA Fine Jewellery is responsible for providing exceptional customer service, driving sales conversion, and building long-term customer relationships. 3. Support local area activities in collaboration with the Relationship Executive.

5. Follow up with potential customers and visit them to close sales.
6. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships.

Desired Skills
1. Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
2. Proven track record of meeting sales targets.
3. Detail-oriented and organized.
4. Ability to work well in a team.
5. Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays.

Job Description: QA / QC Trainee Pharmaceutical MNC
Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
Position: Quality Assurance (QA) Trainee / Quality Control (QC) Trainee
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: Fresher – 2026 Pass-Out
Education: B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy)
Salary: As per company standards
Job Overview
We are hiring B.Pharm freshers (2026 pass-outs) for entry-level opportunities in Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) with a reputed multinational pharmaceutical company.
This is an excellent opportunity for fresh pharmacy graduates to begin their careers in pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality systems, laboratory testing, and regulatory compliance.
Selected candidates will receive practical exposure to pharmaceutical quality standards, manufacturing processes, documentation, and quality control procedures under the guidance of experienced professionals.
1. Job Responsibilities – Quality Assurance (QA)
The QA Trainee will assist the Quality Assurance team in maintaining product quality and ensuring compliance with pharmaceutical quality standards.
Assist in reviewing and maintaining GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) documentation.
Support preparation and maintenance of Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packaging Records (BPR).
Assist in maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other quality documents.
Support in-process quality checks and manufacturing area inspections.
Assist in documentation review and verification of compliance with approved procedures.
Learn about deviations, investigations, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions), and change control procedures.
Support line clearance activities and production documentation checks, as authorized.
Assist in maintaining data integrity and proper documentation practices.
Participate in internal audits, quality reviews, and compliance-related activities under supervision.
Follow applicable safety, hygiene, and pharmaceutical quality requirements.
2. Job Responsibilities – Quality Control (QC)
The QC Trainee will assist the Quality Control team in laboratory testing and quality evaluation of pharmaceutical materials and products.
Assist in sampling and testing of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished products as per approved procedures.
Learn and perform laboratory testing under supervision.
Understand basic analytical techniques such as titration, pH measurement, and other applicable chemical and physical tests.
Gain exposure to analytical instruments such as HPLC, UV-Visible Spectrophotometer, and other laboratory equipment, depending on the assigned department.
Assist in maintaining laboratory records, test reports, worksheets, and analytical documentation.
Support preparation of reagents, solutions, and laboratory materials as per approved procedures.
Follow laboratory safety practices, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), and applicable GMP requirements.
Assist in calibration checks and routine maintenance documentation of laboratory instruments.
Understand out-of-specification (OOS) and out-of-trend (OOT) results and their investigation procedures under supervision.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and compliance within the laboratory.
Note: Candidates will be assigned to either QA or QC based on the company's requirements, candidate suitability, and available openings.
3. Candidate Eligibility
B.Pharm graduates who have completed their degree in 2026.
Freshers with no prior full-time work experience are eligible to apply.
Basic understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, and GMP concepts.
Good communication, documentation, and analytical skills.
Attention to detail and willingness to learn pharmaceutical quality systems.
Ability to follow standard procedures and work in a regulated manufacturing environment.
Willingness to work in shifts, if required by the company.
Candidates must meet the employer's applicable eligibility and documentation requirements.
4. Key Skills Required
Basic pharmaceutical and analytical knowledge.
Understanding of GMP, GLP, and SOPs.
Documentation and record-keeping skills.
Basic knowledge of laboratory instruments and testing procedures.
Attention to detail and a quality-oriented mindset.
Teamwork, discipline, and a learning attitude.
5. Career Opportunities
Selected candidates can build their careers in the following areas:
Quality Assurance (QA)
Quality Control (QC)
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Quality Systems
Laboratory Testing and Analytical Quality Control
GMP Compliance and Documentation
Pharmaceutical Audits and Quality Management Systems
6. Application Process
Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume along with the following details:
Educational Qualification: B.Pharm
Year of Passing: 2026
Current Location
Willingness to work in shifts, if required

Fresh B.Pharm graduates of 2026 looking to start their careers with an MNC pharmaceutical company are encouraged to apply.

Description:
WE ARE HIRING PROGRAM ADVISOR | B2C SALES

Job Location: Andheri East, Mumbai
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)

Work Schedule
* Working Days: Monday to Saturday
* Working Hours: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
* Weekly Off: Sunday
* Training: 7 days

Indicative Salary Range
* Freshers: Up to 30,000 per month
* Candidates with Sales Experience: Up to 40,000 per month
* Candidates with EdTech Sales Experience: Up to 50,000–55,000 per month

Important Salary Note: These are indicative maximum ranges, not guaranteed offers. Do not commit or promise any salary to candidates. Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, current CTC and interview performance. Experienced candidates may be considered for a 10–15% hike based on their current compensation and suitability.

Eligibility Criteria
* Any graduate can apply.
* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.
* MBA background preferred for candidates with sales experience.
* Experience in EdTech, B2C Sales, Inside Sales, Counselling, Banking, Insurance or Real Estate Sales is relevant.
* Strong communication, persuasion and objection-handling skills are essential.
* Must be comfortable with high-volume calling and sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
* Counsel prospective students and working professionals about educational programs.
* Drive admissions and achieve monthly enrolment targets.
* Handle inbound and outbound leads and convert prospects into admissions.
* Explain program benefits, fees and admission procedures.
* Follow up with prospects throughout the sales cycle.
* Maintain lead records and follow-ups in CRM.
* Handle objections and close high-value sales.

Daily KRA – Mandatory
* Minimum 150+ calls per day.
* 2–3 hours of daily talk time.
* Consistent follow-ups and lead conversion.
* Ability to work in a target-driven sales environment.

Program Ticket Size
1,20,000–1,50,000 per program. Candidates must be comfortable counselling prospects about high-value educational programs and converting them into admissions.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.
AboutCompany: About OYO: OYO is one of the leading global travel and hospitality brands, offering a wide range of accommodations through its extensive network of hotels and homes. With a strong presence in over 80 countries, we are transforming the way people experience travel and stay. We are looking for passionate, dynamic, and result-driven individuals to join our team and help drive growth in our B2B Travel and Corporate Sales domain.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.
