Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.

Experience

Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.

Description:
Job Summary
CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with disabilities and members of other marginalized communities. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equal society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. To ensure smooth field implementation, coordination with schools and communities, and quality delivery of inclusive education and accessibility interventions at the grassroots level.


Responsibilities
Field Operations Activity Planning
Lead planning and scheduling of field activities across program components and outcomes.
Coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities in schools and communities.
Ensure timely execution of field plans and support the Project Manager with progress updates.
Coordinate with school authorities, block officials, and contractors for the renovation of
Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
Ensure all modifications meet disability-inclusive accessibility standards.
Training Capacity - Building Coordination
Organize and coordinate training for teachers, special educators, and school staff.
Manage training logistics, including scheduling, venue coordination, materials, and
Support implementation of inclusive education practices promoted under Samagra Shiksha.
Community Field Team Supervision
Supervise Community Mobilizers and ensure effective outreach and engagement across all
Guide field teams in community awareness, school engagement, and inclusion activities.
Ensure consistent program coverage and quality implementation at the grassroots level.
Therapy Services Child Support
Coordinate with therapy centers to facilitate services for children with disabilities.
Arrange transport and support mechanisms to ensure regular access to therapy services.
Track participation and follow-up of children receiving therapy and educational support.
Monitor field progress and document implementation challenges.
Prepare regular updates and structured field reports for the Project Manager.
Support data collection and reporting for program monitoring and donor reporting
Ensure adherence to disability-inclusive standards in all school-level interventions.


Professional profile and requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Work, Disability Studies, or a related field, or a B.Ed. in Special Education, or a Diploma in Special Education
2-3 years of experience in field coordination or program implementation in education, rehabilitation, or community development projects.
Prior experience working on inclusive education or programs for children with disabilities under initiatives such as Samagra Shiksha will be preferred.
Experience coordinating with schools, community stakeholders, and local government officials in


Skills
Strong coordination and communication skills for effective stakeholder engagement, including school interactions, home visits, and community sensitization on disability inclusion.
Proficiency in basic digital tools for monitoring and reporting, including Excel and mobile-based applications for IEP tracking and program data management.
Willingness to travel extensively across districts in Tripura, with strong cultural sensitivity to disability inclusion and community norms.


Other requirements
The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India\'s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India\'s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India\'s safety security.
Eight hours per day

- OT ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.

Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.
Develop teaching and learning materials focused on Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) for different grades or contexts.
Design and facilitate online and in-person training and capacity-building sessions for enumerators, teachers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct refresher training and follow-up learning circles to reinforce capacity building and improve delivery quality.
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree in Education, Social Science, or a related field.
Experience
1-2 years of proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, or program implementation.
Prior experience in on-ground or field-based roles is preferred.
Exposure to training facilitation, monitoring, or stakeholder coordination will be an advantage.
Understanding of Social Emotional Learning (SEL), mental health, or child psychology is preferred.
Characteristics
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Bengali (non-negotiable).
Knowledge of other regional dialects in Tripura will be preferred.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and coordination skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Proficient in Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfortable with digital reporting systems.
Highly motivated, empathetic, and driven by childrens wellbeing.
A self-starter who acts with urgency, takes initiative, and learns quickly.
Comfortable with regular travel across districts for field visits, training, and coordination.
Open to experimentation, collaboration, and feedback in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.
Deeply committed to integrity, transparency, and trust in both process and relationships.
If youre someone who is driven by purpose, excited to build, and energized by working closely with communities in service of childrens wellbeing, wed love to hear from you. We care more about your drive, alignment, and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.

Graduate in any discipline.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Strong command of English (both written and verbal).

Description:
Director / Manager Business Development and Customer Success
Tripura Multinational was started to tap into the vast unaddressed opportunities in Leadership Capability Transformation within businesses operating in Asia Pacific, Japan, India and the Middle East. With the business environment changing at a rapid pace, and customer expectations rising significantly, it is incumbent on every organization to build the next generation of skills and capabilities within their teams, and to empower their managers to amplify the impact of those skills through the power of coaching.
We are looking for an individual with a passion for Selling, Sales Management and Customer Success. If you have experience selling People and Capability Transformation solutions to Global Business and Human Resource Leaders, then this job is for you.
Responsibilities
Lead by example on the quality of your customer engagement that our Sales and Leadership Programs seek to exemplify.
You would ideally be proactive with an internal drive for excellence and an external orientation for customer centricity and success.
You would play a strategic role in expanding the client/customer base. You would actively prospect, position, qualify leads, close the deal and sell the gamut of our program offerings.
You would independently build a territory plan segmenting your markets and focusing your execution.
Manage and build the CRM for your territory with discipline, consistency and commitment. Daily updates are encouraged.
Develop and deliver a yearly/quarterly plan linked to sales performance management with measurable KPIs for pipeline progression and conversion.
Possess the gravitas to drive 2-3 CXO meetings every week.
Draft proposals with measurable and monetizable business value that will aid acceleration in your sales cycle.
Maintain good relationships with all existing and prospective clients and collaborate internally with teams like Marketing, Finance and Operations.
Identify market trends and customer requirements that brings insights and foresights back into the business.
Qualifications
You ideally possess 10-15 years of experience in Business Development with comprehensive knowledge and experience working in B2B businesses, preferably selling professional services.
You have engaged in end-to-end sales cycle progression as an independent contributor performing both hunting roles for new customer acquisition and farming roles for cross-selling/up-selling to an existing customer.
You are familiar with CRM systems and can showcase field discipline by gleaning insights from the CRM.
You have excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to differentiate yourself through the quality of your articulation and engagement.
You are driven by Innovation and champion bold ideas and new ways of doing things for your customer. You ask challenging and stretching questions which are themselves value for the customer.
Any exposure to training, education, skill development, assessment, human capability development and coaching within organizations would be your additional asset in this role.
This role will report to the Director for Sales Effectiveness and Execution Excellence and will be based in India / Singapore. In Singapore, Singaporeans and Permanent Residents of Singapore will be accorded priority for hire. Others can apply too.
AboutCompany:
Tripura Multinational Pte Ltd is a consulting and leadership development firm specializing in sales transformation, organizational growth, and executive coaching. It partners with global enterprises to enhance leadership capabilities, drive business performance, and foster sustainable growth through tailored consulting and training programs. The company emphasizes innovation, cross-cultural expertise, and measurable impact in its client engagements. Career opportunities highlight its focus on nurturing professionals in consulting, leadership development, and business transformation services.

Position: Full Stack Engineer
Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies, along with experience in cloud platforms, API development, and modern software development practices.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications.
Build scalable and responsive front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Develop robust back-end services using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices.
Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Required Skills:
6+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Strong experience in server-side development using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Good knowledge of database technologies including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools and automated testing frameworks.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Exposure to DevOps practices and monitoring tools.
Understanding of security best practices and performance optimization.

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Policy Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Policy Center.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Work on Guidewire Policy Center capabilities including policy administration, product configuration, underwriting rules, rating, pricing, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




Your Profile

6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Policy Center applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire modules: PolicyCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across policy and policy integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with PolicyCenter, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in PolicyCenter is preferred.




What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire Insurance Suite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.

Greetings from Quest Global!
We have a great opportunity for you, please find the details below.

Experience- 6 to 10 Years
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
Embedded Software Developers
Job Summary:
Design, develop and support real-time embedded software applications for Wabtec Corporation, a leading supplier of technology-based products and services for the rail and transit industries.
Essential Job Functions/Responsibilities:
Analysis, design and development of software for real-time applications on a Linux-like platform using C and/or C++.
Participate in designing, coding, testing, debugging, configuring, and documenting software as per the company’s policies and procedures.
Working with a team to develop solutions that meet project requirements within the program schedule and budget constraints.
Take an active role in systems analysis and design of real time applications, defining interfaces between system segments and software architecture and design.
Facilitate support for fault isolation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis activities during system integration and validation testing.
Triage reported issues to assess impact, determine work arounds and propose solutions.
Assist with activities like requirements, design and code reviews.
Work from Wabtec Bangalore office to have work collaboration.
Qualifications:
BS in Software Engineering/Computer Science/Electrical/Electronics Engineering is required and MS in a similar discipline is a plus with 6 – 10 years of work experience.
A good understanding of Linux operating systems and networking (TCP/IP).
Solid work experience with SCM, change management, defect tracking, software builds and release processes.
Experience in implementing a good development process including requirements tracing with tools like ReqPro, DOORS.
Effective oral and written communication skills, ability to articulate clearly and concisely.
Self-driven, results oriented and a clear focus on high quality, self-motivated: these qualities are a must.
High degree of attention to detail.

Prefer to have people with experience working in the Power Energy industry, working on products such as RMU, RTU, Protection Relay, Gateways, IoT, IED Controllers

Description:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
Experience with enterprise learning technology including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
Excellent technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
Bachelors degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture certification or equivalent experience preferred.

Job Description

We are looking for candidates for Customer Support (CS) and Service Desk (SD) roles who can provide excellent customer service, handle customer queries, and resolve technical and service-related issues. Candidates will act as the first point of contact for customers and service users, assisting them through voice calls, chat, email, and other support channels.

Key Responsibilities

- Handle customer queries and resolve issues through calls, chat, and email.
- Act as the first point of contact for customer and service-related requests.
- Understand customer concerns, analyse problems, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
- Provide technical support for laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation.
- Assist with Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory-related issues.
- Handle requests related to information, system access, and other services.
- Demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Resolve customer issues independently, efficiently, and professionally.
- Maintain good time management and ensure a positive customer experience.
- Be proactive and demonstrate respect for customers' time.

Eligibility Criteria

- Qualification: Any full-time graduate with 15 years of formal education.
- Experience: 15 years, depending on the job level and profile.
- Candidates with prior technical support experience must have at least 1 year of Service Desk Technical Support experience.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Experience in laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Willingness to work in a voice support process and 247 rotational shifts.
- Rotational weekly offs and work from office are mandatory.
- Candidates must have completed double vaccination, as specified in the JD.

Note: Candidates will be screened according to the relevant CS or SD profile, experience, technical skills, and applicable salary budget.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and passionate Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have experience working across both frontend and backend technologies, possess strong problem-solving skills, and be capable of collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using modern frontend frameworks.
Design, build, and manage backend services, APIs, and databases.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers, product managers, and stakeholders to implement business requirements.
Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
Integrate third-party services and APIs as needed.
Continuously evaluate and implement emerging technologies and best practices.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
3-8 years of experience in Full Stack Development (adjust based on requirement).
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
Experience with frontend frameworks such as:
React.js
Angular
Vue.js
Experience with backend technologies such as:
Node.js
Java
.NET
Python
Knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases:
MySQL
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
SQL Server
Familiarity with Git version control systems.
Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with cloud platforms:
Microsoft Azure
AWS
Google Cloud Platform
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of security best practices and OAuth/JWT authentication.
Experience with automated testing frameworks.

Frontend

JavaScript (ES6+)

Docker
Kubernetes

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Nice to Have
Experience working in enterprise-scale applications.
Exposure to AI/ML integrations.
Knowledge of serverless architectures.
Experience in DevOps and infrastructure automation.

Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote (as applicable)

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

As an Oracle Technical - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our business application consulting team, specializing in Oracle technology. You will be responsible for analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support to optimize operational efficiency and help clients achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will utilize and manage the Oracle suite of software and technologies, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of Oracle products and solutions.

Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and management of Oracle software solutions to optimize client operations
- Analyzing client needs and developing tailored Oracle technology strategies to achieve business objectives
- Overseeing the installation, configuration, and administration of Oracle products and solutions
- Guiding teams in the development and support of Oracle Application Development Framework (ADF) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher and Oracle Data Integration to enhance data-driven decision-making
- Driving process improvement and optimization initiatives within client environments
- Coaching and mentoring team members to develop their skills and deliver quality outcomes
- Collaborating with clients to address challenges and provide strategic technology planning
- Embracing change and fostering a culture of innovation and digital tooling within teams
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships to support business transformation efforts
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Computer and Information Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in technical, integration, database, or related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) domains
- Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle Application Development Framework (ADF) and Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher
- Utilizing strategic technology planning to drive business transformation initiatives
- Embracing AI fluency and AI-human collaboration for innovative solutions
- Excelling in process improvement and optimization within Oracle environments
- Leading teams with a focus on coaching and feedback to enhance performance

Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

A Geographic Information System (GIS) is a computer system that analyzes and displays geographically referenced information. Geographic information system(s), GIS
GIS is a technology that is used to create, manage, analyze, and map all types of data.
GIS connects data to a map, integrating location data (where things are) with all types of descriptive information (what things are like there). This provides a foundation for mapping and analysis that is used in science and almost every industry. GIS helps users understand patterns, relationships, and geographic context. The benefits include improved communication, efficiency, management, and decision-making.

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. - Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
