Demonstrate proficiency in SCCM administration for effective desktop management and system updates.
Have a strong understanding of finance and accounting domain requirements to tailor cloud solutions accordingly.
Exhibit expertise in device management and SPM to optimize system performance and user experience.
Show capability in collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve project goals.
Display strong analytical skills to evaluate system performance and implement improvements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry standards and best practices in cloud architecture.

Key Responsibilities:
Data Exploration and Analysis:
They use statistical methods and tools to explore data, identify patterns, and uncover relationships within the data.
Data Visualization:
They create charts, graphs, and dashboards to visually represent data findings and make them easier to understand.
Reporting and Communication:
They communicate their findings to stakeholders through reports and presentations, translating complex data into actionable insights.
Collaboration:
They often work with other teams, such as marketing, sales, or engineering, to understand their data needs and provide relevant insights.
Data Collection and Preparation:
Data analysts collect data from various sources, clean it by removing errors and inconsistencies, and prepare it for analysis.
Skills Required:
Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and solve problems.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages like SQL, Python, or R, as well as experience with data visualization tools.
Communication Skills: Ability to clearly communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to identify and address data-related issues.
Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the specific industry or business area they are working in.
Where Data Analysts Work:
Data analysts work in various industries, including:
Business and Finance:
Analyzing sales data, market trends, and customer behavior to improve business strategies.
Healthcare:
Analyzing patient data, disease patterns, and treatment outcomes to improve healthcare delivery.
Technology:
Analyzing website traffic, user behavior, and product performance to improve product development and marketing.
Government:
Analyzing crime statistics, public health data, and economic trends to inform policy decisions.
In essence, data analysts bridge the gap between raw data and actionable insights, enabling organizations to make data-driven decisions and achieve their goals.

Description:
Job Summary
Our creative and talented Physical Design team in Bangalore, India. As a member of this team you will be involved in creating next generation state-of-the-art networking chips in advanced process node. You will drive the backend process through the entire RTL 2 GDS Implementation flow including hierarchical floor planning, place route, timing closure, power integrity, static timing verification, physical verification and equivalence checks, with special focus on performance die size optimization.


Your Impact
Analyzes current generation quality and efficiency gaps to identify proper incremental or evolutionary changes to the existing physical design related Tools, Flow and Methodology.
Work closely with various teams such as physical design, RTL, DFT, tool/flow owners, and EDA vendors to improve physical design methodologies.
Good understanding of different CTS strategies and providing the feedback to Implementation Team.
As member of physical design team, drive methodologies and best known methods to streamline and automate physical design work.
STA setup, convergence methodology, reviews and sign-off for Multi-Mode and Multi-corner designs.
Good at Timing ECO Implementation strategy development/convergence. Should have an experience in enabling the Tweaker/Primetime based ECO flows.
Work on Automation scripts within STA tools for Methodology development Excellent debugging skills in implementation issues and ability to produce creative solutions.
Evaluate multiple timing methodologies/tools on different designs and technology nodes.
Good scripting skills (TCL/SHELL/PERL/Python) is a MUST


Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors or a Master s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required
You are an ASIC engineer with 11+ years of related work experience with a broad mix of technologies including:
All aspects of ASIC Physical implementation including Floor planning, Clock and Power distribution, global signal planning, I/O planning and hard IP integration.
Hierarchical design implementation approach, Timing closure, physical convergence.
Power Integrity Analysis
Experience with large designs (>100M gates) utilizing state of the art sub 16/14/7/5/3nm technologies.
Familiarity with various process related design issues including Design for Yield and Manufacturability, multi-Vt strategies.


Preferred Qualifications
Floor planning and PR tools: Cadence Innovus Synopsys ICC2
Synthesis Tools: Synopsys DC/FC
Formal Verification : Synopsys Formality and Cadence LEC
Static Timing verification: Primetime-DMSA
Power Integrity : Apache Redhawk
Physical Design Verification Synopsys ICV, Mentor Calibre
Scripting: TCL, Perl is required; Python is a plus

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).

Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.

This is an Individual contributor role.

The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.

¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career

¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or

oerings.

senior working professionals.

Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

mindset with a strong work ethic; enthusiastic about learning new tech aligned to strategy.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).

Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

We are looking for experienced and qualified Site Safety Officers to manage Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) activities at our project sites across India.

Description:
Manager, Global Process Excellence

Transformation | Global Process Excellence | Global Procurement Solutions

Job Title Manager, Global Process Excellence ,
Location Ahmedabad, India

Role Purpose
The Manager, Global Process Excellence is a hands-on transformation leadership role within the Transformation team, responsible for driving and executing the modernization of Source-to-Pay processes, technology, and ways of working across SAP ECC 6.0, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP Ariba (SAP Business Network). Reporting to the Associate Director, Global Process Excellence, this role owns the day-to-day execution of transformation workstreams translating the global roadmap into deliverable outcomes ; while ensuring seamless service delivery to the business during the transition.
The role requires direct, working-
level involvement in SAP transformation delivery (not solely oversight): partnering with IT, functional, and BPO teams on configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and hypercare activities, while building strong relationships across Procurement, Accounts Payable, IT, Shared Services, and external suppliers/partners.
Key Responsibilities
Transformation Execution: Drive and personally execute assigned workstreams of the Global Transformation Agenda, partnering with Global/Zone teams, Global Service Excellence, and Global GBS Capabilities to deliver measurable business impact.
SAP ECC to S/4HANA Migration: Provide hands-on execution support across migration phases ; requirements, process design, configuration validation, data migration support, integration/UAT testing, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization support.
SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network: Lead hands-on execution of Ariba modules (e.g., sourcing, contracts, procurement, supplier network) implementation and optimization, including supplier enablement, catalog/PO configuration validation, and network transaction troubleshooting.
Roadmap Delivery: Support development and execution of the 3-year Transformation Roadmap (Expansion, Digital, and Process Transformation initiatives) in collaboration with stakeholders, technology partners, and BPO partners.
Continuous Improvement: Lead the Continuous Improvement (CI) framework across the Source-to-Pay process, identifying opportunity areas and partnering with Global GBS Capabilities to execute and deliver value.
Technology Optimization: Drive platform optimization and utilization (SAP ECC/S4HANA/Ariba and adjacent digital/AI tools) in partnership with Global Functions and the Zones.
Risk, Controls & Compliance: Manage transformation-related risk, compliance, and access controls in collaboration with internal audit/controls teams, including access/role adherence and issue remediation.
Governance & Reporting: Define and track transformation KPIs, run operating reviews, manage escalations, and report progress to the Associate Director and senior stakeholders.
Change Management: Drive adoption, communications, training, and supplier/user experience improvements associated with SAP transformation releases.
Stakeholder Management: Build and manage global relationships across Procurement, AP, IT, Services, and external suppliers/partners to ensure scalable processes that meet service standards and business outcomes.
Qualifications & Experience
15+ years of combined Operational and Transformation experience, including exposure to global or regional roles.
Proven, hands-on experience personally driving and executing SAP ECC 6.0 to S/4HANA transformation and SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network trouble shooting / Implementation this is a working, execution-level requirement, not solely a governance/oversight requirement.
Practical exposure to NextGen AI-enabled solutions within Source-to-Pay / Procurement technology landscapes is an advantage.
Strong process management skills: standardization, optimization, documentation, controls, and scalable service delivery.
Governance & KPI expertise: ability to define metrics, run operating reviews, manage escalations, and ensure compliance.
Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire global/virtual teams, including driving operational excellence with offshore BPO providers.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to executive leadership.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to use data-driven insights to inform decisions and drive improvements (root cause analysis, defect reduction, cycle-time improvement).
Ability to influence without authority at team and stakeholder levels; strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills across functions and levels.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or an advanced degree is a plus.
Fluency in English (written and verbal) required.

Description:
Associate / Sr. Associate (TA Operations)

Position: Associate / Sr. Associate
Department: TA Operations Business
Location: KFintech GIFT City, Gandhinagar
CTC: 2.5 3.5 LPA
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO) Only
Working Days: 5 Days a Week + Alternate Saturdays (2 Saturdays Working per Month)
Joining Preference: Immediate Joiners

About the Role
KFintech is seeking enthusiastic and detail-oriented professionals to join the TA Operations team at GIFT City. The role involves handling investor servicing, transaction processing, operational activities, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and process requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Process investor transactions and Transfer Agency (TA) operational activities.
Verify and maintain investor records, account information, and KYC documentation.
Ensure accurate and timely execution of transactions within defined SLAs.
Handle investor queries and coordinate with internal stakeholders for resolution.
Prepare and maintain MIS reports, operational trackers, and related documentation.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, regulatory guidelines, and operational procedures.
Support process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and service quality.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and record maintenance activities.

Eligibility Criteria
Education: B.Com, M.Com, BBA, BBM, or any Commerce-related degree. (with minimum of 60% and above)
Experience: 03 years.
Freshers with strong academic credentials are welcome to apply.
Experience in financial services, back-office operations, mutual fund operations, TA operations, or customer servicing will be an added advantage.

Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Basic knowledge of financial services and investor servicing.
Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office applications.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Profile
Commerce background candidates.
Immediate joiners or candidates serving short notice periods.
Candidates with exposure to Mutual Fund Operations, Transfer Agency Operations, Registry Operations, or Financial Services Operations preferred.

Compensation & Benefits
CTC ranging from 2.5 LPA to 3.5 LPA based on qualifications and experience.
Opportunity to build a career in the financial services and investor servicing domain.
Exposure to industry-leading operational processes and regulatory frameworks.

Preference will be given to immediate joiners willing to work from the KFintech GIFT City office on a WFO basis.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Perform day-to-day operation of the Solvent Recovery Plant (SRP) as assigned.
Monitor critical process parameters including feed flow, temperature, pressure/vacuum, reflux, steam, condensate and solvent concentration.
Operate and monitor MVR, packed/distillation columns, WFE, ATFD, pumps, vacuum systems and associated utilities.
Troubleshoot process and equipment abnormalities including vacuum fluctuations, fouling, choking and unstable operation.
Manage shift operations, manpower allocation, shift handover and logbook maintenance.
Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
Maintain operational records, checklists, deviations and equipment history.
To manage and support to Supervisor for daily routine operations task as assigned.



Preferred candidate profile :
SCADA Experience: Hands-on experience in SCADA operation, monitoring trends, alarms, interlocks, PID loops and troubleshooting instrumentation and control valves.
Centrifugal Turbo Compressor (MVR System) Experience: Experience in operation of high-speed centrifugal turbo compressors used in MVR systems including start-up, shutdown, surge protection and performance monitoring.
Packed Column Distillation Experience: Hands-on experience with packed column distillation, reflux and vacuum control, temperature profile monitoring and solvent-water separation.

Requirement:

Must be ready to work in a shift.
Ready to work in Site at Matoda, Ahmedabad.
AboutCompany:
Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

Job Title: Manager Compliance
Location: GIFT City, Ahmedabad

Role Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Compliance Officer to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements within GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City). The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of IFSC (International Financial Services Centre) regulations, RBI, SEBI, PFRDA, and IFSCA guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory Compliance:
In-depth knowledge of GIFT City / IFSC Regulations and PFRDA guidelines applicable to Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs).
Ensure compliance with IFSCA (International Financial Services Centres Authority) regulations and SEZ (Special Economic Zone) guidelines.
Monitor and implement RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI regulations applicable to entities operating in GIFT City.
Develop and maintain policies and procedures to comply with Indian and international regulatory standards.

2. Risk & Governance:
Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies.
Monitor regulatory changes and update internal policies accordingly.
Ensure adherence to AML (Anti-Money Laundering), KYC (Know Your Customer), and FATCA requirements.

3. Audits & Reporting:
Liaise with regulators, auditors, and stakeholders to ensure compliance.
Prepare and submit regulatory reports to IFSCA, RBI, SEBI, and other relevant bodies.
Handle regulatory inspections and audits efficiently.

4. Training & Awareness:
Conduct training sessions for employees on regulatory requirements.
Promote a compliance-oriented culture within the organization.

5. Operational Compliance:
Review transactions for any suspicious activities and report to relevant authorities.
Ensure proper record-keeping and documentation as per IFSC norms.

Qualifications & Skills:
Education: CA / CS / LLB / MBA (Finance) / CFA / FRM or equivalent.
Experience: 5+ years in compliance roles, preferably in BFSI, NBFC, or Fintech.
Strong understanding of IFSCA regulations, SEBI guidelines, RBI circulars, and global compliance frameworks.
Knowledge of AML, KYC, PMLA (Prevention of Money Laundering Act), FATCA, and CRS regulations.
Experience in regulatory reporting, audit handling, and governance frameworks.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving regulatory environment.
Work closely with the IT and Operations teams for data extraction, process checks, and system enhancements to ensure compliance automation.

Preferred Qualifications:
Prior experience working with **foreign banks, IFSC units
Must have cleared relevant NISM certifications for securities markets, AIFs, mutual funds, and depositories.

 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.

We are seeking applications for the position of Engineer Bridges for Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Bangalore
Missions/Main Duties
Take responsibility for Metro Rail bridge design, viaduct Structure design.
Prepare reports and calculations in line with International Codes of Practice (AREMA, AASTHO, EURO).
Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections, including recording of all relevant information
Can perform bridge assessment calculation and report.
Manage delivery of projects
Preparation of estimates for work items.
Identify scope change items.
Knowledge of working on big multi-disciplinary projects on BIM.
Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to Company ISO Standards.
Profile/Skills
BE-Civil + M.Tech in Structural Engineering
2 to 5 years of experience into relevant field.
Experience on Software requirement Sofistik, Midas, Oasys.
Actively working towards Professional qualification.
Ability to work in a collaborative multi-discipline design team.
Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others.
Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required.
We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It s not a job - it s a career!

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Strategic & P&L Management

Market Intelligence

Sales, Business Development & Channel Management

6. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation mastery, cross-cultural communication, and basic technical understanding of foil-stamping machinery and substrates.

Job Title: Academic Counsellor / Sr. Academic Counsellor
Department: Business Development / Admissions
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Days: 6 Days (Mon-Sat), Work From Office
Note: 1 South Indian language is mandatory for Bangalore location(kannada/Telugu preferred)
Job Overview
We are looking for a target-oriented Counsellor to handle lead generation, student counselling, sales, and admissions. The role involves guiding students, parents, and working professionals on educational programs, study-abroad opportunities, and career-oriented training while ensuring smooth enrolment and achieving business targets.
Roles & Responsibilities
Generate leads through calls, digital platforms, referrals, and promotional activities.
Counsel students and parents on courses, eligibility, career opportunities, and study-abroad options.
Manage the admission process, including applications, documentation, follow-ups, and enrolment.
Guide study-abroad applicants on university selection, applications, and visa-related procedures in coordination with relevant teams.
Promote educational programs and training services to prospective customers.
Achieve counselling, admission, and sales targets through effective lead conversion.
Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and reports using CRM tools or Excel.
Coordinate with internal teams and institutional partners for smooth admissions and onboarding.
Required Skills
Excellent communication, counselling, and negotiation skills.
Strong sales orientation and target-achievement mindset.
Good relationship management and follow-up skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification & Experience
Graduate in any discipline,postgraduate qualification preferred.
1+years of experience in counselling, admissions, sales, business development, or education consulting.
Study-abroad or Online Degree sales experience is an advantage.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Remuneration:

An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

The opportunity : Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


GOV
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.


SaT
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.


SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Car Inspection Engineer to
conduct comprehensive inspections of used cars sourced through dealer partners. The role is
responsible for accurately assessing a vehicle’s mechanical condition, body condition,
structural integrity, and overall quality, while ensuring standardized inspection processes and
transparent reporting.

What You Will Do:
Conduct detailed physical inspections of used cars at dealer locations, customer locations, yards, and designated inspection centers. 
Assess key vehicle systems including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, tyres, steering, electrical systems, AC, and other mechanical components. 
Inspect the exterior and interior condition of vehicles, including body panels, paint quality, dents, scratches, accidental repairs, and signs of structural damage. 
Identify critical vehicle issues such as flood damage, major accidents, odometer tampering, structural damage, and significant mechanical defects. 
Conduct road tests to evaluate vehicle performance, drivability, handling, braking, and overall condition. 
Verify VIN/chassis number, engine number, registration details, and other relevant vehicle documents. 
Use diagnostic tools, inspection equipment, mobile applications, and digital platforms to conduct standardized vehicle assessments. 
Prepare accurate and detailed inspection reports with photographs, observations, identified defects, and recommendations. 
Identify approximate refurbishment/repair costs and clearly highlight major repairs or quality concerns. 
Complete inspections and reports within defined Turnaround Time (TAT). 
Clearly communicate critical defects, major repairs, and vehicle quality concerns to internal teams and dealer stakeholders 
Follow defined inspection SOPs, checklists, quality standards, and safety protocols. 
Maintain accurate inspection records and ensure data quality on the inspection platform/mobile application. 
Identify recurring vehicle quality issues and provide actionable feedback to improve inspection processes, standards, and quality controls. 
What we are looking for:
ITI, Diploma, or Graduate qualification in Automobile Engineering. 
3–5 years of relevant experience as an Automobile Evaluator, Mechanic, Service Advisor, Assistant Service Advisor, or similar role. 
Experience working with passenger vehicles and strong understanding of automotive systems and components. 
Strong multi-brand vehicle technical knowledge. 
Ability to identify accidental damage, mechanical defects, structural issues, and major repair requirements. 
Hands-on experience with vehicle diagnostic tools and inspection applications will be preferred.
Strong attention to detail with excellent observation and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and unbiased inspection reports. 
Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and digital inspection platforms. 
Willingness to travel extensively for vehicle inspections. 
Valid driving licence and practical driving skills preferred. 
What we will give you:
Opportunity to work with modern digital inspection platforms, diagnostic tools, and technology-enabled processes. 
A fast-paced environment where your technical expertise directly influences vehicle quality and business decisions. 
A role with strong ownership, autonomy, and visibility in a growing automotive business. 
A performance-driven environment with opportunities for learning, growth, and career progression. 
At OLX India, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
We embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you are as excited as we are about this position and our company, we hope you join us! To learn more, take a look at our website.
