Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job Title: Interior Designer Livspace
Locations: Chandigarh | Indore | Bhopal
About Livspace
Livspace is a leading home interiors and renovation platform that simplifies the home interiors journey for homeowners. We combine design, technology, and execution excellence to create beautiful, functional spaces.
Role Overview
As an Interior Designer at Livspace, you will own projects end-to-end, from the first client interaction to final closure. You will combine design expertise, customer empathy, and business ownership to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.
Key Responsibilities
Translate customer requirements into functional and aesthetically appealing space plans.
Own and deliver complete interior design deliverables.
Provide an exceptional, trust-led customer experience.
Manage the project pipeline and achieve monthly revenue targets.
Ensure a smooth and seamless handover of projects to execution teams.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of experience in residential interiors, including modular interiors and space planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, B.Arch, or equivalent qualification; alternatively, a 2–3 year diploma with 2+ years of residential interiors experience.
Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar design tools.
Experience in client-facing roles or design-and-build environments.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
High ownership mindset and comfort working in a target-driven environment.
Interested candidates can share their profiles at:
saurabh.jain02@livspace.com

Description:
Role Description:
This is a full-time, on-site Product Promotion Manager role based in Chandigarh, with a field-based business development focus. As a key member of the BMA team, you will be responsible for driving the strategic expansion of Bharat Medtec Ascents innovative and patented product portfolio across Chandigarh and the adjoining northern region. This leadership-oriented role requires a seasoned professional who can navigate complex hospital procurement cycles, build high-level clinical partnerships, and execute effective market-entry strategies for new medical technologies. The role also involves engaging with hospitals and healthcare providers, gathering market and customer feedback, and sharing insights with product and leadership teams to refine product positioning and strategy. The Product Promotion Manager will track key performance metrics, prepare regular reports, and contribute to building scalable and repeatable business development frameworks for multiple Medtec products.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Market Expansion: Identify and penetrate untapped market segments within corporate hospital chains, government institutions, and private nursing homes across the assigned region.
Key Account Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), hospital administrators, and procurement heads.
Clinical Collaboration: Partner with surgical and medical teams to conduct product demonstrations, coordinate clinical training, and promote specialised devices through value-based selling.
Regulatory & Compliance: Ensure all business activities comply with applicable guidelines and international ethical standards for medical device marketing.
Tender Management: Lead the end-to-end institutional tender process, from technical specification development to commercial bid submission.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of proven experience in medical device sales or business development. Experience in Neurology, Cardiology, Diagnostics, or other therapy areas is welcome.
Education: Bachelors degree in Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or Pharmacy. An MBA in Marketing or Healthcare Management is highly desirable.
Regional Expertise: An established professional network within the Chandigarh healthcare ecosystem is highly desirable.
Technical Proficiency: Ability to discuss complex clinical outcomes and technical specifications with senior surgeons and specialists.
Analytical Prowess: Proficiency in market mapping, competitor analysis, and CRM-driven sales forecasting.
AboutCompany:
About Bharat Medtec Ascent (BMA)
Bharat MedTec Ascent (BMA), an initiative of HS Foundation India, is a product promotion platform dedicated to helping Indian MedTech startups successfully commercialise their innovations. We bridge the gap between product development and market adoption by enabling validated medical technologies to reach healthcare providers and patients across India.
Through a structured Product Promotion Program, BMA supports startups in building commercial readiness, strengthening clinician engagement, expanding sales and distribution networks, facilitating product adoption in both government and private hospitals, and enabling access to institutional procurement and tender opportunities. Backed by 40+ experienced product promotion professionals, clinical experts, and industry partners, we help innovators navigate the complexities of the healthcare market and accelerate sustainable growth.
Our mission is to enable indigenous MedTech innovations to scale faster, strengthen India's healthcare ecosystem, and contribute to a self-reliant future in medical technology.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
As an Interior Designer, you should have excellent creative thinking skills and be able to create modular designs based on conversations with a client. You should be confident communicating regularly with clients in order to assess their needs and be able to adjust a given approach based on feedback. You should maintain familiarity with the Interior Design landscape and trends in order to provide the best idea for the client.
Key Responsibilities:
To own the sales funnel and drive sales closure.
To own customer experience during a project.
To lead and own quality and accuracy of design deliverables.
To own an end-to-end project lifecycle.
EXPERTISE AND QUALIFICATIONS
B.Arch / B.Des from a design college.
Minimum experience of 2 years as an Interior Designer.
Led and delivered a minimum of 2 to 4 residential modular KWS projects.
Excellent knowledge of design tools, PPT presentation and AutoCAD.
Conceptual Design: Expertise in layout, style and mood boards.
Technical Design: Material knowledge, execution and drawing preparation.
Modular Design: Material knowledge, aesthetics and functionality, and module planning.
Civil Works & Services: Knowledge of specifications and installation details.
Project Expertise: Creating BoQs for customers and coordinating with internal and external agencies.
Sales Expertise: Sales closure through a logical and trusted sales pitch, driving and leading design meetings with customers.
Behavioural Attributes: Result-oriented, teamwork, integrity and ethics, and crisp and meaningful communication.
A high degree of willingness to learn and the ability to drive performance among independent team members.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asia's largest and fastest-growing home interiors and renovation platform. Leveraging its proprietary technology, the company delivers end-to-end home interior and renovation solutions, encompassing modular solutions, furniture, false ceilings, soft furnishings, dcor, civil works, and more. The company serves homeowners across diverse market segments in India and Singapore.

About the Role

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join the Marketing team at upGrad. Opportunity to contribute to one of India's leading EdTech organizations.

Learning and development opportunities across diverse business functions.

I hope you are doing well.
I am reaching out regarding an exciting opportunity with BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) for the position of Deputy Manager Medical Affairs based in Chandigarh.
This role is ideal for a healthcare professional who enjoys engaging with clinicians, building KOL relationships, driving clinical education initiatives, and partnering closely with commercial teams to enhance healthcare outcomes.
About the Role
As a Deputy Manager Medical Affairs, you will play a key role in executing clinical strategies across the region by:
To execute and implement Clinical Strategies for MDS in the respective regions / territory in line with the market requirements and the country business plan with the purpose of creating clinically differentiated market position.
Principal Responsibilities
Conduct Clinical Marketing Education Programs, Seminars, Promotional Events and In-service Programs in the respective region in order to improve BD MDS value proposition amongst both clinical and economic buyers, by engaging KOLs towards MDS business outcome and achieve regional business objectives.
Clinical capability building (administering trainings, continuous evaluation) amongst regional MDS direct selling organization and amongst channel partners in line with the country clinical objectives in order to enhance their ability to adequately differentiate the brand MDS in the market and thus achieve targeted business outcomes.
Creating and implementing the regional calendar of engagements with the potential / existing customers in order to create strong brand awareness and creating door openers at the relevant levels.
Support / assist sales organization with product evaluations, clinical audits in hospitals, setting protocols and processes in hospitals and 'critical to business' technical challenges (including but not limited to troubleshooting and product applications) in order to attain high levels of product penetration, query resolution and trouble free product application.
Leading edge key customer relationship management and creation of regional KOL network in order to ensure usage of full array of BD MDS products by leading client organizations and using these customer relationships to drive the conversions.
Coordinate on the timely completion of clinical /economic studies initiated in the region in order to ensure that the clinical / economic studies planned for the year are completed within the stipulated timelines.
Conduct Induction Training Programs (Clinical & Product Training) to Sales Organization, provide clinical Updates, annual / quarterly Product refreshers and run Clinical Proficiency Tests on a need basis / from time to time.
Preferred Background
We are particularly interested in professionals with:
MBBS qualification (MBA preferred)
3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Medical Affairs
Clinical Affairs
Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL)
Clinical Education
Scientific Affairs
Clinical Applications / Clinical Specialist roles
Strong experience in:
KOL development and physician engagement
CME/CNE programs
Clinical training and education
Hospital stakeholder management
Product demonstrations and evaluations
Cross-functional collaboration with commercial/sales teams
Exposure to:
Medical Devices
Diagnostics
MedTech
Pharma
Critical Care
Infusion Therapy
Infection Prevention
Vascular Access
Willingness to travel extensively (70-80%) across North India.
Why Consider BD?
BD is a global leader in medical technology, advancing the world of health by improving medical discovery, diagnostics, and the delivery of care. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals, clinicians, and healthcare decision-makers while contributing to meaningful patient outcomes.
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career aspirations, I would be happy to connect and share further details.
Please feel free to reply with your updated resume and a suitable time to speak.
Looking forward to hearing from you.
AboutCompany: BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world and is advancing the world of healthTM by improving medical discovery, diagnostics and the delivery of care. The company supports the heroes on the frontlines of healthcare by developing innovative technology, services and solutions that help advance both clinical therapy for patients and clinical process for healthcare providers. BD and its 75,000 employees have a passion and commitment to help enhance the safety and efficiency of clinicians' care delivery process, enable laboratory scientists to accurately detect disease and advance researchers' capabilities to develop the next generation of diagnostics and therapeutics. BD has a presence in virtually every country and partners with organizations around the world to address some of the most challenging global health issues. By working in close collaboration with customers, BD can help enhance outcomes, lower costs, increase efficiencies, improve safety and expand access to healthcare.

About Us: We are a skilling company, driven by the promise of a brighter India, vision of connecting formal education with practical skilling to create job ready students for BFSI. We are one of the largest corporate training companies in BFSI Industry and have been providing corporate learning solutions for 15 years to employees and professionals in Banking, Asset Management, Wealth Advisory, Insurance, Financial Distribution and Broking Companies.
FinX focuses on employability and employment for students, its subsidiary CIEL (Centre for Investment Education & Learning) focuses on corporate trainings, upskilling and Financial Awareness.
Role Overview: As the Area Manager - Business Development you will drive strategic partnerships with Universities, Colleges, MBA Institutes, Other educational institutions for BFSI focused vocational courses in your location. You will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth, expanding business opportunities, and shaping the company's business growth. You will focus on securing key business mandates and building deep relationships with Vice Chancellors, Directors, Principals & HODs. This role requires a strong business acumen, relationship building experience, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams to achieve ambitious growth targets.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Building with Education Institutions: Establish and nurture strategic partnerships with Educational Institutions for our Industry focused vocational courses for their students with improved learning & placement outcomes.

Joint Management/PG/UG Programs: Lead efforts to secure mandates for customized BFSI Industry focused Joint programs wherein curriculum design, delivery, placement shall be our primary responsibility e.g. PGDBM (Financial Services), BCom (Capital Markets), PGDM( Banking, Lending & Credit)

Certifications: Drive alliances & initiatives to drive FinX Job- Readiness Certifications on BFSI, Wealth Management, Stock Markets, Equity, Debt, Lending, Alternate Assets etc. These certifications also have sales & behavioral skills embedded for a 360 degree perspective of knowledge & application

Short Courses: Embedding BFSI focused specialized trainer led short courses and NISM Certifications along with regular academic curriculum of UG/PG/ Management to improve knowledge level & employability profile of students e.g. Mutual Funds, Research Analyst, Equity Derivatives, Investment Banking, Financial Markets, Portfolio Management Services

Revenue Growth: Own and drive revenue growth, identifying new business opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and building a pipeline of potential clients.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (product, marketing, operations) to ensure smooth delivery of solutions that meet client needs.

Client Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.


Market Insights: Stay updated on market trends, competition, and opportunities, using insights to shape business development strategies.

Skills & Experience:
Proven track record (4 -7 years) in business development, corporate sales, or enterprise partnership roles, ideally in skilling, education, or HR services sectors.
Experience in BFSI ( Banks, KPOs, NBFCs , Mutual Funds, Broking, Insurance etc)
Strategic thinker with a business acumen and proven track record of execution
Excellent networking, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, start-up like environment.

We are looking at incumbents with the following qualities / skill set:

Ambitious
High energy and passion
Ability to build a business grounds-up
Believe in building long term relationships
Hard Working & Persistent
Good Communication Skills
Integrity, Ethics & Process Orientation

Why Join Us:

Be a key member of a mission-driven company aspiring to make a significant impact on skilling a future ready workforce. Shape the future of work by contributing to the growth of a platform that empowers people worldwide.
Competitive salary and benefits, with opportunities for professional growth and development.
This job description is designed to attract a seasoned relationship manager with the strategic vision and proven track record of execution needed to support the growth and expansion of FinX

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR

- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.

- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.

- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:Driving NetPromoter Score
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs plan
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership

People development (Attrition Control)

training modules

execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions
are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards
SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the store

Description:
Profile Summary

Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Driving Sales and Customer Service

a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually

b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store

c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership

d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.

e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.

f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.

h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

Manpower Planning & People Development

a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates

c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.

d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives

e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.

f. Overall responsibility for associate development

Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores

a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level

b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage

d. Managing the productivity of the staff

e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory

Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations

a. Regular Store Visits to:


Audit stores

Coaching the Store Managers

Motivate staff through sales discussions

Check VM, stock availability

Check store hygiene, grooming

Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.


b. Analyze data before Store Visits


Monitoring Sales through data.

Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores

Store Staffing levels.

Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.

NPS and MC scores

Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets


a. Bridge communication between Management and floor


Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.

Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.

Implementing and enforcing company regulations

Implement process change

Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets


Inventory Management

a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores

c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores

d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed

e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner

f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level

g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Key Personal and Professional Attributes:

a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.

b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.

c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.

d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.

e) Extroverted Personality

f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached

g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient

h) Passionate

i) Energetic

j) Positive Attitude

k) Ability to handle stressful situations

l) Problem Solving & Decision Making

m) Assertive

n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player

Candidate Profile:

a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry

b) Post-Graduation is a must

c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator

d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word

e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)

f) Sales oriented

g) Strong Management/leadership skills.

h) Strong organizational skills.

i) Strong team builder

Required Managerial Competencies

People Management

a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.

b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.

c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.

d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner

Proactive Problem Solving Skills

a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.

b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.

c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.

d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation

Commercial Savviness

a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.

b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.

c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints

Customer Expectation Management

a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer

b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests

c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required

Planning and Organizing

a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments

b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches

c) Delegates work effectively among team members

Required Personality Traits

a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves

b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior

c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings

d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.

e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern

f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Job Summary
NagaEd is seeking a Program Manager to lead the implementation, monitoring evaluation (ME), and stakeholder engagement for a portfolio of school education programs in rural areas. Based in Nagaland, this role is crucial in ensuring that these programs are delivered effectively, aligned with community needs, and contribute to improving teaching quality and school outcomes. The Program Manager will work closely with schools, teachers, government bodies, and communities to ensure smooth execution across programs. The role will involve managing junior team members, contributing to program design, and ensuring that stakeholder voices are integrated into program implementation and improvements.
Organisational Unit Function
1. Program Implementation
Oversee and coordinate the implementation of a portfolio of education programs and school improvement initiatives in rural schools across the assigned districts.
Ensure all program interventions align with state and national education policies (e.g., NEP 2020).
Support teacher training sessions and ensure schools adopt best practices across programs.
Identify and resolve challenges in program execution, ensuring smooth rollout of each initiative.
Work collaboratively with internal teams to provide field-level insights that refine program strategies.
2. Monitoring Evaluation (ME)
Track progress against objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each program.
Conduct field visits to monitor teacher effectiveness, student learning, and school improvements across the program portfolio.
Collect and analyze qualitative and quantitative data to measure program impact.
Prepare reports and case studies to document lessons learned and best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations for program adjustments based on findings.
3. Stakeholder Community Engagement
Serve as the key liaison between NagaEd, school administrators, teachers, and local communities.
Organize meetings, focus groups, and discussions to gather stakeholder feedback on program delivery.
Ensure community voices are integrated into program design, delivery, and ongoing improvements.
Work closely with local government education authorities, NGOs, and community leaders to build support for interventions.
Act as a bridge between stakeholders and NagaEd's internal teams, ensuring two-way communication.
4. Team Supervision Support
Provide guidance and manage junior program staff supporting field activities.
Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, ensuring team members have the resources needed for success.
Ensure smooth coordination between field teams and internal teams across all programs.
Reporting Relationships
Reports to: Director
Supervises: Junior Program Officers, Field Coordinators (if applicable)
Communications (Internal/External)
School Administrators; Teachers - Implement training, ensure school adoption of interventions across programs
Government Education Authorities - Align programs with policies, secure support
Community Leaders; Parents - Gather feedback and ensure community involvement in education initiatives
NagaEd Team (Program Design, ME, and Training Teams) - Share field insights to refine interventions across the program portfolio
Selection Criteria
Essential
3+ years of experience in program management, implementation, stakeholder engagement, or ME.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, Social Work or a related field.
Strong coordination and field-level execution skills, ensuring smooth program implementation.
Experience in data collection, analysis, and reporting for ME activities.
Ability to liaise with local communities, education authorities, and school leaders.
Strong interpersonal skills, able to facilitate discussions and consultations with diverse stakeholders.
Willingness to be based in Nagaland, and travel to rural schools.
Desirable
Experience working in teacher training or school improvement programs.
Prior experience in community-driven program implementation.
Job Details
Location: Kohima
Probation: 3 Months

COMPUTER TEACHER JOB DESCRIPTION
Position

Computer Teacher
Responsibilities
Provide quality computer training to students in the assigned school and conduct classes
online when required.
Plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate computer lessons using clear explanations,
demonstrations, activities, and practical sessions.
Conduct regular computer laboratory/practice sessions and guide students through
hands-on exercises.
Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, presentations, worksheets, assignments, and
practice exercises.
Conduct students assessments in a timely manner, including class tests, practical
assessments, assignments, and project work.
Evaluate student performance, provide constructive feedback, and support students who
require additional guidance.
Maintain student assessment data, attendance, records, and documentation of the
programs work in the school.
Use student-centered teaching methods and encourage participation, questioning,
problem-solving, creativity, and practical learning.
Maintain classroom discipline and ensure responsible use of computers, internet
resources, and laboratory equipment.
Conduct classes as per applicable government guidelines and the school’s academic
requirements.
The instructor has to conduct classes at ZPHS.
Support school-level administration of the project and complete project-related work
assigned by the reporting officer.
Coordinate with school staff and the reporting officer regarding schedules, student
progress, assessments, and program activities.
Deliver sessions in English and the official language of the state, as required.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of computer fundamentals, operating systems, file management, and
basic troubleshooting.
Proficiency in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Knowledge of internet usage, email, online safety, digital citizenship, and basic cyber-
safety practices.

Knowledge of coding/programming concepts and ability to teach age-appropriate coding
through languages or platforms such as HTML, CSS, Python, Scratch, or similar tools.
Ability to conduct practical computer laboratory sessions and guide students through
coding and application-based exercises.

Ability to use digital teaching tools, online classrooms, presentations, multimedia
resources, and educational software.
Basic understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, networking concepts, and
common software installation/troubleshooting.
Ability to prepare digital learning materials, assessments, and student-performance data.
Teaching & Classroom Skills
Create structured lesson plans aligned with the prescribed curriculum and
government/school guidelines.
Explain technical concepts in simple, student-friendly language and adapt teaching to
different learning levels.

Use demonstrations, practical exercises, group activities, projects, quizzes, and real-
world examples to make lessons interactive.

Monitor student understanding during lessons and provide timely remedial support.
Manage classroom and computer-lab behavior while promoting a safe, respectful, and
inclusive learning environment.
Track learning outcomes and use assessment results to improve teaching and student
support.
Encourage students to develop logical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, digital
confidence, and responsible technology use.
Qualifications
B. Tech (any branch), MCA, or M.Sc. (Computer Science).
Any graduation with coding training certification.
Candidates with M. Tech / B. Ed. are given preference.
Experience
1+ years of experience in IT training, with familiarity in assessments, evaluation, and
practice sessions.

Nagaland (Wokha)

Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Description:
The Educator, Art Labs will lead and facilitate impactful, art-based learning sessions in classrooms, promoting creative expression and social-emotional development among children. This role will involve regular observation and documentation of classroom dynamics and student engagement. This role will shape the holistic growth of the children by driving a community-building movement in our model school, thereby creating strong evidence on art and SEL in classrooms.


Roles and Responsibilities

1. School Scouting and Art Lab Development
Identify and visit potential schools where Art Labs can be set up.
Assess schools based on available space, infrastructure, student strength, school leadership, and readiness to support an Art Lab.
Meet principals and teachers to understand the schools needs and assess the feasibility of setting up and sustaining an Art Lab.
Document school visits and share findings to support school selection and planning for Art Lab setup.
Coordinate with selected schools to support the setup of Art Labs and their integration into regular school activities.


2. Government Engagement and Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain relationships with relevant state and district government officials, including the Education Department, SCERT, DIET, and other relevant institutions.
Share SArCs approach and work with government stakeholders and explore opportunities to establish and strengthen Art Labs in schools.
Coordinate with government officials, funders, and school leadership to facilitate school visits, address implementation needs, and support program delivery.
Work with artists, volunteers, and creative professionals to bring additional art experiences to children.


3. Art Facilitation and Classroom Engagement
Facilitate joyful and inclusive art sessions for children from Grades 1 to 8 throughout the academic year.
Adapt existing art lesson plans to suit childrens needs, interests, and classroom contexts while keeping the intended learning outcomes in mind.
Create a classroom environment where children feel comfortable expressing themselves, sharing ideas and exploring their creativity.
Guide children through reflection and discussion to help them express their thoughts, listen to others, and develop self-awareness.
Design visual teaching aids and lead school-wide art projects, exhibitions and installations that give children opportunities to explore relevant social and community themes through art.


4. Field Observations and Research
Conduct school visits and structured classroom observations to understand how art education is practised, and the challenges schools and teachers face.
Collect information through classroom observations, interviews with teachers and school leaders, and other research tools as required.
Support research studies on art education, teaching practices, student engagement and the implementation of Art Labs.
Prepare field visit reports, case studies and summaries of findings, highlighting challenges, patterns and practices that can inform program decisions.
Work with the Research and Impact team to plan school visits, collect data and maintain accurate records.


5. Curriculum and Monitoring and Evaluation (ME)
Work closely with the Curriculum and ME teams to share feedback from classrooms and schools on the relevance, suitability, and implementation of art activities.
Identify gaps in lesson plans, teaching resources and facilitation approaches based on classroom experiences, teacher feedback and student participation.
Share specific recommendations on what needs to change in the curriculum, activities or teaching resources to meet childrens needs better and address classroom realities.
Support the Curriculum team in reviewing and testing revised activities and resources, and share feedback on their effectiveness.
Work with the ME team to document classroom observations, track student progress, and assess whether sessions are meeting their intended outcomes.
Maintain relevant program records, including classroom dashboards, field notes, and documentation of childrens work, to support program review and improvement.


Qualifications and Experience
A graduate degree in Education, Arts, Child Development, or a related field is required. A postgraduate degree is an added advantage.
3-4 years of experience in teaching and classroom facilitation, preferably in creative learning or arts-integrated settings.
Experience working with low-income or underserved school communities will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of child-centred pedagogy, experiential learning and childrens social-emotional development.
Experience in classroom observation, documentation and using feedback or data to improve teaching and learning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work with children, teachers, school leaders, government stakeholders and internal teams.
Alignment with Saturday Art Classs vision of making arts education an integral part of public school education.
Skills and Mindset
Facilitation and empathy: Creates inclusive spaces where children feel safe to express themselves and explore their creativity.
Curriculum adaptation: Can work with art-based curricula and adapt activities and lesson plans to suit childrens needs, abilities and classroom contexts while keeping learning objectives in mind.
Ownership and organisation: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes, manages multiple priorities and meets deadlines with minimal supervision.

Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).

The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
