Role Overview

Position Details: Associate Professor - Paediatrics; 2 positions; Department of Paediatrics; reports to the Professor / Head of Unit; work location: Gangtok, Sikkim.

This mid-senior academic-clinical role combines undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised clinical service, assessment, research guidance, and assigned unit administration. The incumbent will help MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students build safe, evidence-informed paediatric knowledge and practical competence. The role supports high-quality outpatient, inpatient, emergency, NICU, and PICU care while contributing to patient satisfaction and continuous improvement. The Associate Professor works under the Professor / Head of Unit and may lead unit activities when authorised.

Employer Profile: A confidential tertiary-care academic teaching hospital integrating paediatric care, medical education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver competency-based lectures, tutorials, bedside teaching, demonstrations, and clinical discussions for MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students.
Formulate the rotational undergraduate teaching schedule and coordinate faculty inputs to maintain complete, timely academic coverage.
Plan, conduct, and document internal examinations and periodic assessments using approved standards, blueprints, records, and constructive learner feedback.
Supervise seminars, case presentations, journal clubs, clinical postings, procedural learning, and academic mentoring across paediatric services.
Provide outpatient and inpatient paediatric care with the unit team and support evidence-informed diagnosis, treatment, discharge, and follow-up decisions.
Serve as first on call for paediatric emergencies on assigned duty days and escalate difficult or unstable cases promptly.
Supervise or perform appropriate procedures in the NICU, PICU, outpatient department, wards, and emergency settings within authorised privileges.
Report complex, high-risk, and emergency cases to the Unit In-charge or Head of Department and document decisions accurately.
Cover assigned consultant responsibilities during approved leave or service gaps to maintain continuity of teaching and patient care.
Lead assigned unit administration, including duty rosters, work allocation, coordination, and staff guidance, when delegated.
Support need assessment, specification development, procurement inputs, and responsible utilisation of paediatric medical equipment.
Guide learner and departmental research through question development, protocol review, ethical practice, analysis, writing, and dissemination.
Advance patient satisfaction, safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, audit, and continual clinical-service improvement.
Maintain academic, clinical, research, and statutory records while completing other duties assigned by the Head of Department.

Required Qualifications
The candidate must hold an MBBS degree and an NMC-recognised MD or DNB in Paediatrics, or another qualification formally accepted as equivalent under the regulations in force. A valid NMC or State Medical Council registration is mandatory. The candidate must satisfy the applicable Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, including prescribed research-publication, biomedical-research, and medical-education training requirements, as verified at appointment.

Required Experience
The standard academic pathway requires 4+ years as Assistant Professor in Paediatrics at an NMC-recognised medical institution; 5+ years is required where the candidate's applicable NMC route prescribes the longer threshold. Any alternative statutory pathway must be fully documented and independently verified. Relevant experience must include formal undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, clinical supervision, and paediatric patient care. Demonstrated exposure to NICU, PICU, outpatient, inpatient, and emergency services in a teaching-hospital environment is essential.

Technical and Functional Skills
Paediatric clinical assessment, decision-making, documentation, referral, discharge planning, and escalation across OPD, wards, NICU, PICU, and emergencies.
Competency-based medical education, lesson planning, teaching schedules, internal assessment, question setting, evaluation, feedback, and academic recordkeeping.
Clinical supervision of learners and safe oversight of authorised paediatric and neonatal procedures within institutional protocols.
Research methods, ethics, literature appraisal, protocol development, data interpretation, manuscript guidance, and NMC-compliant publication evidence.
Quality improvement, patient safety, infection prevention, audit, duty-roster planning, equipment inputs, and multidisciplinary coordination.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear academic communication, structured feedback, learner mentorship, and respectful collaboration with students, faculty, nurses, and allied teams.
Compassionate family communication, ethical judgement, cultural sensitivity, confidentiality, and calm leadership during paediatric emergencies.
Accountability, dependability, adaptability, prioritisation, conflict resolution, and commitment to continuous professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates with a strong teaching portfolio; completed NMC-recognised faculty-development courses; eligible research publications; demonstrable academic or clinical quality-improvement work; experience guiding postgraduate research; and additional documented competence in neonatology, paediatric intensive care, medical education, or clinical research. These preferences do not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Professional Tenure and Background
Expected progression includes recognised postgraduate training, Senior Residency or an accepted equivalent pathway, and an Assistant Professor appointment meeting the applicable 4+ years or 5+ years NMC threshold. JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Associate Professor

Department Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy

Reporting To Head of the Department / Professor

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital, affiliated with a renowned university for medical education in the Northeast region

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy will assume a pivotal academic and clinical leadership role at a premier teaching hospital in the Northeast region of India. The incumbent will be responsible for delivering high-quality medical education to undergraduate MBBS and postgraduate students, providing advanced dermatological patient care across OPD, IPD, and emergency settings, and driving research and publication initiatives within the department. This role demands an exemplary balance of clinical expertise in skin diseases, sexually transmitted infections, and leprosy with a strong commitment to academic excellence in a university teaching environment.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver structured theoretical and practical lectures for Undergraduate (MBBS) students and Postgraduate medical students in accordance with university curriculum requirements.
Conduct bedside clinical teaching, case-based discussions, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.
Mentor and guide postgraduate residents in case presentations, thesis formulation, and scholarly research.
Participate actively in curriculum development, examination processes, and academic assessment methodologies.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required, ensuring uninterrupted academic continuity.

B. Clinical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots, maintaining high clinical standards.
Manage inpatient cases admitted under the unit and provide expert consultation for inpatient referrals across departments.
Attend emergency cases during on-call duties and ensure prompt, evidence-based clinical management.
Perform and supervise diagnostic and therapeutic dermatological procedures including skin biopsies, cautery, laser treatments, and minor surgical interventions.
Diagnose and manage skin diseases, leprosy, sexually transmitted infections, and related complications.
Participate in scheduled Operation Theatre duties to perform procedures and oversee postgraduate surgical training.
Ensure accurate and timely documentation of patient records, adherence to clinical protocols, and NABH quality standards.

C. Research & Publications
Lead and participate in departmental research projects and clinical trials.
Publish scientific papers in national and international indexed journals as per NMC requirements.
Submit articles and medical opinion pieces to media and scientific forums on a regular basis.
Guide and evaluate postgraduate thesis work to ensure academic rigor and compliance with university standards.

D. Administrative & Institutional Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration and academic planning.
Participate in hospital quality improvement initiatives, NABH compliance activities, and patient safety protocols.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programs, workshops, and national/international conferences.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department as institutional needs evolve.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy from a recognized institution.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)
Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Dermatology at a recognized medical institution; OR
Minimum 5 years as Assistant Professor in Dermatology at a Government medical institution (for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor); OR
Armed Forces Specialist Medical Officer with at least 5 years of post-PG clinical experience in the relevant specialty, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Must have published at least 2 research publications after becoming Assistant Professor; candidatemust be among the first three authors.
Must have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognized institution designated by NMC.
Must have undergone or be willing to undergo the Basic Course in Medical Education (where the specialty is covered under UG training).
Minimum 1 year of working experience as Senior Resident in a recognized medical college or teaching hospital (preferred).

Regulatory Compliance
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Preference will be given to candidates with a proven academic track record in a recognized university or college setting.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical Expertise
Skin disease diagnosis & management
STI / Venereology expertise
Leprosy diagnosis & treatment
Dermatosurgery & procedures
Laser & advanced therapies
Emergency clinical management

Academic & Research
UG & PG medical education delivery
Indexed journal publication
Thesis guidance & mentoring
Curriculum development
NMC regulatory knowledge
Biomedical research methodology

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong communication skills
Team leadership & management
Organized & detail-oriented
Patient-centric approach
Adaptability to teaching hospital

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - Forensic Medicine & Toxicology is a full-time academic faculty position responsible for teaching, assessment, medico-legal practice, research, and departmental service. The role supports undergraduate MBBS students, postgraduate medical students, and interns through competency-based instruction, supervised practical learning, and reliable academic evaluation. Reporting to the Head of Department, the incumbent will contribute to autopsy services, expert opinions, court duties, curriculum delivery, and institutional responsibilities. The position requires sound professional judgment, ethical conduct, accurate documentation, and the ability to connect forensic principles with clinically and legally relevant practice.

Key Responsibilities
a. Deliver structured lectures, practical demonstrations, tutorials, seminars, and supervised training for MBBS, postgraduate medical students, and interns.
b. Design teaching schedules, lesson plans, learning resources, competency maps, and assessment activities aligned with the approved curriculum and applicable NMC standards.
c. Conduct medico-legal autopsies and related examinations within authorized scope, maintaining accuracy, dignity, biosafety, evidence integrity, and complete contemporaneous records.
d. Prepare clear post-mortem reports, medico-legal opinions, certificates, and advisory inputs for authorized public authorities when formally required.
e. Attend court proceedings, present impartial medical evidence, explain findings within professional competence, and maintain secure case documentation.
f. Develop and administer internal assessments, practical examinations, viva voce evaluations, university examinations, feedback processes, and remediation plans.
g. Guide student research, dissertations, presentations, and scholarly projects while ensuring ethical approval, methodological rigor, and responsible research conduct.
h. Undertake independent and collaborative research, contribute to publications, and participate in seminars, webinars, conferences, workshops, and continuing professional development.
i. Maintain the departmental museum, specimens, displays, registers, inventories, teaching aids, and associated documentation in accordance with safety and ethical requirements.
j. Coordinate assigned departmental activities, academic records, accreditation evidence, timetables, examination duties, and other responsibilities delegated by authorized institutional leadership.
k. Complete or maintain applicable faculty-development requirements, including biomedical research and medical-education training prescribed by current regulations or institutional policy.
l. Uphold confidentiality, impartiality, chain-of-custody controls, professional ethics, infection prevention, quality systems, and respectful interprofessional collaboration.

Required Qualifications
MBBS and MD/DNB in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology from institutions and programmes recognized for faculty eligibility under current National Medical Commission requirements are mandatory. The candidate must hold active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or NMC-recognized registration authority, as applicable. DNB candidates must satisfy any additional teaching-equivalence or Senior Residency requirement applicable to the awarding institution and prevailing regulations. All degrees, registrations, experience records, and equivalence documents must be valid and independently verifiable.

Required Experience
The minimum requirement is one year of qualifying post-PG experience in the concerned subject, normally as a Senior Resident in a recognized medical institution, or another pathway expressly recognized under current NMC regulations. Recognized alternatives may include eligible postgraduate Tutor experience, qualifying Armed Forces experience, or qualifying government-hospital service, subject to documentary verification and the conditions prescribed for that pathway. Candidates should demonstrate relevant exposure to medical teaching, medico-legal autopsy work, report preparation, court processes, and departmental administration. A total of 2-4 years of relevant post-PG teaching or medico-legal experience is preferred.

Technical and Functional Skills
The role requires working knowledge of forensic pathology, toxicology, thanatology, medical jurisprudence, autopsy technique, injury interpretation, preservation and dispatch of samples, chain of custody, medico-legal documentation, expert opinion, and courtroom testimony. The candidate should be able to apply competency-based medical education, curriculum planning, student assessment, feedback, research methodology, ethics, scientific writing, and basic biostatistical interpretation. Proficiency with presentation software, digital learning platforms, academic records, literature databases, and routine office applications is expected.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Essential behaviours include integrity, impartiality, discretion, attention to detail, calm decision-making, clear written and oral communication, and respect for legal and ethical boundaries. The incumbent must teach complex or sensitive material with maturity, collaborate effectively with students, clinicians, administrators, laboratory teams, law-enforcement personnel, and judicial stakeholders, and manage competing academic and medico-legal priorities. Reliability, empathy, cultural sensitivity, accountability, and commitment to continuous learning are central to success.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference may be given to candidates who have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and relevant medical-education or faculty-development training; have verifiable publications, conference presentations, or student-guidance experience; and have handled court testimony, curriculum development, university examinations, accreditation documentation, or museum curation. Training in research ethics, good clinical practice, educational technology, simulation, or quality improvement will strengthen the candidature.

Professional Tenure and Background
An appropriate career path includes MBBS, recognized postgraduate specialization in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, and qualifying post-PG experience. The preferred profile offers 2-4 years of relevant exposure in recognized medical colleges, teaching hospitals, authorized medico-legal services, or other institutions accepted under current NMC pathways. Progressively responsible teaching, autopsy, court, research, assessment, and departmental assignments are valued.

Compensation and Benefits
The appointment offers competitive, role-aligned compensation and faculty benefits governed by institutional policy, qualifications, verified experience, and internal parity. Applicable benefits and any professional-development, conference, or research support will be communicated during the selection process.

Application Instructions
Applicants should submit a curriculum vitae, qualification certificates, registration proof, eligibility and experience records, publication list, and verifiable evidence of teaching, autopsy, court, research, and academic administration. Applications must be accurate and complete; eligibility and experience will be verified.

Role Overview
The Associate Professor of General Surgery is a senior academic-clinical faculty position responsible for undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised surgical training, patient care, assessment, research, and departmental service. The role reports to the Head of Department or Professor and works across classrooms, bedside clinics, outpatient and inpatient services, emergency duty, and operation-theatre schedules. This is an on-site appointment in Gangtok, Sikkim. The appointee will strengthen learner competence, safe surgical practice, clinical governance, and patient satisfaction through disciplined teaching and continuous improvement. The employer is a confidential tertiary teaching hospital integrating patient care, education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured lectures, tutorials, demonstrations, and clinical classes for MBBS students in alignment with the approved curriculum.
Conduct postgraduate seminars, case discussions, journal clubs, clinical meetings, and bedside teaching for General Surgery trainees.
Mentor interns, residents, and postgraduate students in clinical reasoning, procedural competence, professional conduct, documentation, and patient communication.
Plan and implement competency-based teaching, formative feedback, workplace-based assessment, and remedial support for learners requiring improvement.
Serve as an internal or external examiner when appointed and contribute to fair, confidential, and evidence-based undergraduate and postgraduate assessment.
Attend scheduled outpatient clinics, evaluate new and follow-up patients, establish management plans, and maintain timely clinical records.
Manage inpatients admitted under the assigned unit and respond appropriately to interdepartmental referrals requiring surgical evaluation.
Provide emergency surgical assessment and treatment during allocated on-call duties, escalating complex cases through established clinical pathways.
Perform scheduled and emergency operations within credentialed privileges while supervising postgraduate trainees according to competence and patient-safety requirements.
Lead perioperative planning, informed-consent practice, antibiotic stewardship, infection prevention, morbidity review, and safe discharge coordination.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology, nursing, allied health, and other specialties to deliver multidisciplinary care.
Contribute to ethically approved research, indexed publications, clinical audits, conferences, continuing medical education, and departmental academic output.
Advance patient satisfaction and service quality by reviewing feedback, resolving care concerns, monitoring outcomes, and implementing measurable improvements.
Provide reasonable faculty coverage during colleagues leave and undertake additional academic, clinical, administrative, or public-education duties assigned by the Head of Department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised under applicable Indian medical-education requirements.
MS or DNB in General Surgery from a recognised institution; DNB equivalence must satisfy the conditions applicable to teaching appointments.
Valid medical registration under applicable law and eligibility to practise the specialty without restriction.
Documented eligibility for appointment as Associate Professor in General Surgery under current National Medical Commission requirements.
Completion of required Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research, or a valid pathway permitting completion within the prescribed period after appointment.

Required Experience
The standard teaching pathway requires at least 4 years of documented experience as Assistant Professor in General Surgery in a recognised medical institution, together with the research and faculty-development requirements applicable under current NMC regulations. Candidates qualifying through another expressly permitted NMC pathway, including the relevant cumulative post-postgraduate government-hospital experience route, may also be considered after documentary verification. Experience must include independent and supervised operative care, OPD and inpatient management, emergency surgery, undergraduate teaching, postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, and postgraduate supervision. All experience, appointment orders, relieving records, teaching evidence, registration records, publications, and course certificates must be verifiable.

Technical and Functional Skills
Broad-based general surgical assessment, diagnosis, decision-making, operative planning, and postoperative management.
Independent performance of procedures within credentialed scope and safe supervision of trainee participation.
Emergency surgery, trauma evaluation, resuscitation coordination, escalation, and perioperative risk management.
Outpatient, inpatient, referral, critical-care interface, discharge, follow-up, and continuity-of-care workflows.
Competency-based medical education, curriculum delivery, bedside teaching, assessment design, feedback, and remediation.
Clinical documentation, informed consent, medical records, patient confidentiality, medico-legal awareness, and ethical practice.
Research methods, literature appraisal, clinical audit, manuscript development, publication ethics, and academic presentations.
Quality improvement, infection prevention, antibiotic stewardship, morbidity-and-mortality review, and patient-safety systems.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear teaching, listening, feedback, counselling, accountability, and interdisciplinary communication.
Calm, respectful, ethical leadership with sound judgement, adaptability, empathy, and appropriate escalation.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Laparoscopic or minimally invasive surgical expertise, plus additional achievement in trauma, critical care, education, simulation, research, quality, digital systems, or mentoring.

Professional Tenure and Background
Preferred candidates will show progressive responsibility through senior residency and faculty service, with at least 4 years as Assistant Professor unless another current NMC-permitted pathway applies. Evidence should include operative exposure, academic work, ethical practice, sound outcomes, and dependable service in recognised teaching or comparably governed institutions.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive a market-aligned academic-clinical package and institutional benefits based on verified experience, credentials, and internal policy. Detailed terms will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Application Instructions
Applicants should submit an updated curriculum vitae with qualification, registration, experience, appointment, publication, and course records. Candidates must state the role and ensure every claim is verifiable. Appointment remains subject to credential review, current NMC eligibility, clinical privileging, references, and approval.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Associate Professor

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Head of the Department / Professor

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) will hold a senior academic and clinical faculty role at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will lead undergraduate and postgraduate medical teaching in forensic pathology, forensic toxicology, medical jurisprudence, and forensic evidence, while overseeing mortuary operations, toxicology laboratory supervision, and medico-legal case management. This is a faculty leadership role requiring a highly experienced academic with strong publication credentials, deep NMC compliance, and demonstrated expertise in forensic medicine in a teaching hospital setting.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, practical sessions, clinical classes, and demonstrations in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as per university curriculum.
Conduct postgraduate (MD/DNB) classes, seminars, and case-based learning sessions in forensic pathology, toxicology, and medico-legal aspects.
Lead and supervise autopsy teaching sessions for MBBS students and PG trainees ensuring pedagogical clarity and adherence to safety and ethical standards.
Mentor postgraduate students in thesis formulation, research methodology, and case study documentation.
Participate in curriculum planning, academic assessment, and examination processes for UG and PG programmes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required, ensuring academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Supervise and oversee toxicology laboratory investigations, ensuring accuracy, chain of custody, and medico-legal compliance of specimens and reports.
Ensure proper mortuary management, including adherence to safety protocols, infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling of remains.
Conduct and supervise medico-legal autopsies, post-mortem examinations, and forensic evidence collection in accordance with legal and institutional standards.
Prepare medico-legal reports and expert opinions for courts, law enforcement agencies, and institutional authorities as required.
Liaise with judicial, police, and government agencies on medico-legal matters affecting the institution and the community.
Ensure compliance with NABH standards in all forensic and mortuary operations.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC criteria, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit medical articles and forensic science commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead and contribute to departmental research initiatives in forensic toxicology, forensic pathology, and medico-legal sciences.
Guide postgraduate students in original research and thesis work.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and quality improvement initiatives.
Participate actively in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality reviews, and institutional committees.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national conferences, and forensic medicine professional bodies.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a recognized institution.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in FMT, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for becoming Associate Professor.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education (where FMT is covered under UG training).
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Expertise
Forensic pathology & autopsy
Toxicology laboratory supervision
Mortuary management & safety
Medico-legal report preparation
Forensic evidence handling
Court expert witness testimony

Curriculum development FMT
Interpersonal & Soft Skills

Strong written & verbal communication
Attention to detail & documentation
Ethical & professional conduct
Team leadership & collaboration
Composure in medico-legal settings

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Ophthalmology will serve as a senior academic and clinical faculty leader at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will be responsible for delivering advanced undergraduate and postgraduate medical education in ophthalmology, providing specialist eye care across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings, and contributing meaningfully to research and publication activities. This role demands an accomplished ophthalmologist with strong academic credentials, surgical expertise, and a demonstrable commitment to shaping the next generation of eye care specialists in a NABH-accredited, NMC-compliant teaching hospital environment.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, and clinical classes in Ophthalmology as per university curriculum requirements.
Conduct postgraduate (MS/DNB) classes, bedside clinics, case presentations, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.
Participate in ward rounds with PG trainees and interns to develop clinical reasoning and examination skills.
Mentor postgraduate residents in thesis formulation, surgical skills, and research methodology.
Participate in curriculum development, examination setting, and academic assessment processes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required to ensure academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Surgical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots providing specialist ophthalmology consultation, diagnosis, and management.
Manage inpatients admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments requiring ophthalmic consultation.
Attend to emergency ophthalmic patients during assigned on-call duties including ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and other ophthalmic emergencies.
Attend scheduled Operation Theatre sessions perform ophthalmic surgical procedures independently and supervise and train postgraduate students in surgical techniques.
Provide specialist ophthalmology services across the full spectrum of OPD, IPD, and emergency ophthalmic care.
Participate in ward rounds and case discussions with junior faculty, residents, and students.
Ensure accurate clinical documentation, NABH protocol compliance, and high standards of patient safety.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC requirements, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead or participate in departmental research projects in clinical ophthalmology, surgical outcomes, and ophthalmic sciences.
Guide postgraduate thesis work and support research training of PG residents.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and resource management.
Participate in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality improvement committees, and patient safety initiatives.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national ophthalmology conferences, and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MS / DNB / MD in Ophthalmology from a recognized institution, as per NMC regulations.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Ophthalmology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in Ophthalmology, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for Associate Professor eligibility.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education, as Ophthalmology is covered under undergraduate training.
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical & Surgical Expertise
Cataract surgery (phacoemulsification)
Glaucoma diagnosis & management
Retinal disease management
Ophthalmic emergency care
Slit-lamp & fundus examination
Surgical training & OT supervision

Patient-centric approach

Description:
Role: Consultant Nephrologist

Organization Overview
This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience Preference: Crucially, priority will be given to candidates who have gained their experience in recognized university or teaching hospital settings.
Note: Experience is strictly counted only after the completion of the super specialization.

Compensation
Salary Range: INR 3.5 Lakhs to INR 4.5 Lakhs per month.
Determination: Final offer will be commensurate with the candidate's specific post-DM / M.Ch experience and expertise.

Additional Information
Nature of Role: This is a full-time Clinical Practitioner position.
Academic Profile: While an academic profile (publications, research) is not mandatory, the clinical expertise gained in an academic environment is highly valued.
Facility Highlights: The selected candidate will practice in a facility that acts as a tertiary care referral centre for the entire state and neighbouring regions, backed by comprehensive support services including a 24-hour central laboratory and blood bank.
AboutCompany: Super Speciality College and Hospital system run by Reouted University

Job Title: Head of Department (HoD) Psychology (Professor/Associate Professor)

Role Overview
The Head of the Department of Psychology will provide visionary leadership to build a high-impact, industry-relevant, and research-driven department. The role requires balancing academic rigor with innovation, student employability, and institutional growth, while ensuring compliance with UGC norms and alignment with NEP 2020.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic & Academic Leadership
Develop and execute a growth strategy for the department (new programs, student intake, branding)
Design industry-aligned curriculum (e.g., clinical practice, organizational psychology, behavioural data science, counselling)
Introduce value-added certifications and interdisciplinary courses
Drive NAAC/NIRF rankings contributions and accreditation readiness

2. Program Development & Innovation
Integrate technology in psychology (e.g., psychometrics tools, data analytics, AI applications in behaviour studies)

3. Faculty Leadership & Talent Building
Implement performance-driven culture (KPIs: teaching quality, publications, student feedback, placements)
Mentor faculty for research output, consulting, and executive education

4. Research, Consulting & Revenue Generation
Build a research and consulting ecosystem (corporate training, assessments, mental health services)
Secure funded projects, consultancy assignments, and collaborations
Establish labs/centres (e.g., Behavioural Lab, Counselling Centre)
Promote publications in Scopus/Web of Science indexed journals

5. Student Outcomes & Employability
Ensure strong placement and internship pipelines (Hospitals, NGOs, EdTech, corporates)
Develop career-oriented training (soft skills, psychometric testing, counselling skills)
Track and improve student success metrics (placements, higher education, certifications)

6. Industry & Institutional Partnerships
Build MoUs with hospitals, corporates, NGOs, schools, and wellness centers
Organize guest lectures, workshops, and live projects
Promote international collaborations and exchange programs

7. Administration & Operations
Manage departmental budgets with a focus on ROI and efficiency
Ensure smooth academic operations, timetabling, and compliance
Handle student grievances and maintain discipline
Contribute to university committees and strategic initiatives

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications
B.A/B.Sc & MA/M.Sc in psychology & Ph.D. in Psychology (mandatory, as per UGC/AICTE norms)
Minimum 815 years of experience in teaching/research/industry
At least 3–5 years in academic leadership roles (HoD/Program Head/Coordinator)
Strong research and publication record

Key Skills & Competencies
Leadership with a focus on growth and revenue generation
Strong networking and industry engagement skills
Ability to balance academic quality with market relevance
Data-driven decision-making and innovation mindset

As a constituent campus of a well-established deemed-to-be university with decades of academic legacy, we offer a vibrant, multicultural environment that draws students and scholars from across the country and beyond. The campus is surrounded by natural tranquility an ideal setting for reflective inquiry and meaningful teaching.

Description:
Job descriptionfor Food and Beverage On Job Trainee - Steward
A Food and Beverage On Job Trainee -Steward is responsible to assist the senior steward inensuring that the kitchen and dining areas are clean and well-organized, servingfood and beverages to guests, and guests' needs and requests are met promptlyand efficiently. On job trainee is responsible for ensuring that all necessarycutlery, crockery, and glassware are available to the guests. It is alsoexpected to learn and follow all health and safety guidelines, includingmaintaining personal hygiene, ensuring food is stored properly, and maintaininga clean and sanitary work environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Welcome the guests by greeting them asper the standards. Respond to customer queries by resolving issues in a timelyand efficient manner to ensure customer satisfaction.
Serving food and drinks: assist in servingfood and drinks to guests. This includes taking orders, delivering food totables, and ensuring that guests have everything they need.
Learning the facilities of the hotel /casino and the daily events and functions in order to satisfy guest enquiries.
Handling guest requests andcomplaints: handle guest requests and complaints. This includes addressing anyissues they may have and providing them with a satisfactory solution.
Learning and following safety andhygiene procedures: required to learn and follow safety and hygiene proceduresto ensure that the kitchen and dining areas are safe and sanitary for guestsand staff.
Learning and following companypolicies: learn and follow the company policies and procedures, including thoserelated to dress code, attendance, and customer service standards.
Attend training sessions to learn new skills and improve existing ones.
Qualifications:
Min HSSC pass, diploma or equivalent required; additional training or certification in food service or hospitality may be preferred.
Strong knowledge of food service operations, including hygiene and sanitation practices.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem solving skill with the ability to prioritize tasks.
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Throughout training period, on job trainee will be supervised byexperienced stewards or captains, who will guide in performing dutieseffectively and efficiently. Hence performance will be evaluated regularly, andwill be provided with feedback and support to help to improve skills andknowledge. Overall, the role of an on-the-job trainee steward in the food andbeverage service department is an important one that requires attention todetail, excellent customer service skills, and a strong commitment to teamworkand collaboration.

Description:
Role Overview
The Librarian will be responsible for the overall management, development, digitisation, and effective utilisation of the University Library and its learning resources. The role goes beyond the traditional management of books and circulation. The Librarian is expected to develop the library as a student-centric Learning Resource Centre that actively supports teaching, research, skill development, employability, innovation, and lifelong learning. The Librarian will ensure that physical and digital resources are easily accessible, appropriately organised, effectively utilised, and continuously aligned with the academic programmes and evolving requirements of Medhavi Skills University.
Key Responsibilities
A. Library Administration & Operations
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the University Library and associated learning/resource facilities.
Develop and implement library policies, SOPs, circulation procedures, membership norms, and operating guidelines.
Ensure systematic acquisition, accessioning, classification, cataloguing, shelving, circulation, and preservation of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of books, journals, periodicals, newspapers, reports, reference materials, and other resources.
Ensure efficient issue, return, renewal, reservation, and recovery of library materials.
Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation of library resources.
Maintain appropriate systems for damaged, lost, obsolete, and withdrawn materials.
Ensure appropriate library timings based on student s and academic requirements, including during examinations and other high-demand periods.
B. Digital Library & Technology
Develop and strengthen the University s digital library ecosystem.
Manage e-books, e-journals, research databases, institutional repositories, online learning resources, and other digital subscriptions.
Ensure effective implementation and utilisation of the Library Management System (LMS/ILMS).
Facilitate remote and campus-based access to digital learning resources wherever applicable.
Promote awareness and usage of digital databases and online academic resources among students and faculty.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled search, research and knowledge management tools, to enhance library services.
Maintain accurate digital catalogues and ensure easy discoverability of resources.
C. Academic & Student Support
Work closely with Heads of Schools, Programme In-Charges, faculty members, and academic teams to understand programme-specific resource requirements.
Ensure availability of textbooks, reference books, journals, case studies, reports, and digital resources required for different programmes.
Conduct library orientation programmes for newly admitted students.
Train students in effective use of catalogues, databases, e-resources, research platforms, and credible online information sources.
Support students in literature searches, assignments, projects, presentations, research, and academic referencing.
Develop initiatives to improve reading habits and library utilisation among students.
Organise book displays, reading campaigns, author interactions, knowledge sessions, quizzes, book reviews, and other library engagement activities.
D. Faculty & Research Support
Assist faculty and researchers in identifying relevant books, journals, databases, reports, and research materials.
Support literature review, reference management, citation practices, and information retrieval.
Facilitate awareness of research databases, open-access resources, institutional repositories, and scholarly publications.
Support the development and maintenance of an institutional repository for research papers, publications, reports, projects, dissertations, and other academic outputs, as applicable.
Coordinate with academic teams for continuous improvement of programme-wise library resources.
E. Acquisition & Resource Development
Prepare annual and periodic plans for acquisition of books, journals, databases, and other learning resources.
Collect recommendations from faculty, Schools, and academic departments.
Evaluate resource requirements based on curriculum, student strength, programme requirements, usage patterns, and applicable regulatory norms.
Coordinate with publishers, vendors, distributors, and service providers for procurement and subscriptions.
Support comparative evaluation and cost-effective procurement of library resources in accordance with University policies.
Monitor subscriptions and ensure timely renewal of essential databases, journals, magazines, and digital resources
F. Compliance, Accreditation & Documentation
Maintain all library documentation required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation, audit and quality-assurance purposes.
Support the University in documentation and data requirements relating to UGC,

The Assistant Professor - Rooms Division will contribute to the delivery and development of industry-oriented education in Front Office, Housekeeping, Accommodation Operations and Rooms Division Management. The role requires a strong combination of academic capability, hotel operations knowledge, practical demonstration skills, student mentoring, industry engagement and applied research.
Key Responsibilities
Teaching Learning
Develop and deliver engaging lectures, practical sessions, and workshops in Room Division subjects
Front Office Operations Guest Registration
Housekeeping Management Laundry Operations
Reservations, Yield Revenue Management
Property Management Systems (e.g., Opera, Fidelio)
Prepare lesson plans, session plans, and assessment tools aligned with CLOs and TLOs
Mentor, coach and advise students to achieve academic and professional excellence
Provide timely feedback on assignments, practical exams, and assessments.
Curriculum Academic Development
Update and revise syllabi to reflect industry best practices and emerging trends, to incorporate current industry practices, technology, and sustainability standards.

Contribute to program accreditation, quality assurance, and periodic curriculum review processes.
Assessment Feedback

Provide timely, constructive feedback and maintain accurate grade records
Supervise end-semester examinations and practical assessments
Industry Engagement Research
Forge and maintain partnerships with hotels, resorts, and industry associations for guest lectures, internships, and site visits
Design and execute applied research or consultancy projects in Room Division (e.g., guest satisfaction studies, housekeeping innovations, front-office technology)
Publish research findings, case studies, and best-practice guides in peer-reviewed journals, conferences, and industry white papers
Present insights at academic and professional conferences to share knowledge and build scholarly reputation
Collaborate on joint projects with hospitality organizations, technology vendors, and industry bodies to drive innovation and practical impact
Industry Engagement
Build and maintain relationships with hotels, resorts, and professional associations for:
Guest lectures and masterclasses
Student site visits and industrial training
Internship and placement coordination
Keep abreast of emerging trends (e-concierge services, smart room technology, sustainablehousekeeping) and integrate them into teaching.
Service Administration
Participate in department and university committees (admissions, student welfare, qualityassurance)
Organize and oversee student-centric events like mock check-ins, workshops, and skill-drills
Ensure compliance with university policies, accreditation standards, and safety/hygiene regulations
Qualifications Skills Required:
Master s degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Tourism Management, or a related field;
Ph.D. preferred.
Minimum of 5 years teaching experience at the undergraduate level
Hands-on experience in Front Office and Housekeeping departments of a 5-star hotel, including familiarity with PMS software.
Demonstrated record of research, publications, or industry projects in Room Division.
What We Offer
Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
1. Academic:
Delivers and conducts Under-graduate student lectures/classes.

2. Clinical:

Sees the inpatients admitted under his unit and also other inpatient referrals.

3. Others:

Any other job assigned by the HOD
SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Great communication skills.
Good management skills.
Responsible and organized individual.
Exceptional research and writing skills.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
Qualification- MBBS and MS/DNB/MD in in the concerned subject and as per these regulations.
Teaching experience, research, and other requirements:
(a) one year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject as specified in a recognised medical institution.
Note 1: The requirement of one-year Senior Resident experience is relaxed for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in Government medical institute immediately before the publication of these regulations.
Note 2: The experience gained by a Tutor in a medical institution of his specialty, having
a postgraduate degree, shall be considered equivalent to the experience required as a
Senior Resident for the purpose of eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor.
Note 3: The experience gained by a Demonstrator in a medical institution of his specialty, having a Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degree, shall be considered equivalent to the experience required as a Senior Resident for the purpose of eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor; or
(b) Specialist Medical Officers of the Armed Forces having at least one year teaching
experience or two years of clinical experience after obtaining the requisite postgraduate qualification in the concerned subject.
Note: In the specialty of Aviation Medicine and Marine Medicine two years of such experience in flying Squadrons and in Diving and Escape training Schools respectively will
be considered equivalent to one year of teaching experience (in lieu of Senior Resident) to become an Assistant Professor; or
(c) a non-teaching Consultant or Specialist or Medical Officer, possessing postgraduate medical degree with at least two years of experience in a Government hospital having at least 220 beds shall be eligible to become an Assistant Professor of that broad specialty without the requirement of experience as Senior Resident and shall complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research within two years of appointment; or
(d) diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognised medical institution
before 08.06.2017 having total experience of four years as Senior Resident; or
(e) diploma holders working as Specialist or Medical Officer in the respective departments
of a government medical institution or Government medical institution running National Board of Examination and Medical Science recognised teaching programme having cumulative experience of six years.

Prepare project documentation and knowledge transfer materials.

6–12 years of SAP experience with 3+ years in SAP BRIM SOM.
Strong experience in:
SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM)
SAP BRIM Solution Architecture
Product Catalog & Product Modeling
Subscription Lifecycle Management
Order Distribution & Fulfillment
Master Data Management

FI-CA

Experience in integration technologies:
SOAP/REST APIs
Web Services

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.

DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment

Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Security Officer
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a vigilant and dedicated Security Officer to join our Security Department within the mining sector. The role demands a proactive professional responsible for safeguarding company assets, personnel, and infrastructure by implementing robust security protocols tailored to the steel manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in industrial security operations, demonstrate strong situational awareness, and effectively coordinate with internal teams and external agencies to maintain a secure and compliant workplace.
Responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and monitor comprehensive security policies and procedures specific to the mining environment to prevent theft, vandalism, and unauthorized access.
Conduct regular security audits and risk assessments across the facility to identify vulnerabilities and recommend corrective actions.
Supervise and coordinate the activities of security personnel, ensuring adherence to company standards and regulatory compliance.
Manage access control systems, including issuance of identification badges and monitoring entry and exit points to maintain strict control over personnel and vehicle movement.
Respond promptly and effectively to security incidents, emergencies, and alarms, coordinating with emergency services and internal stakeholders as necessary.
Maintain detailed and accurate records of security activities, incidents, and investigations for reporting and compliance purposes.
Conduct training sessions for employees on security awareness, emergency response protocols, and safety regulations relevant to the manufacturing industry.
Collaborate with local law enforcement and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with legal and safety standards applicable to the manufacturing sector.
Oversee the maintenance and operation of security equipment such as CCTV systems, alarm systems, and communication devices to ensure optimal functionality.
Implement crowd control measures during shift changes, company events, and emergency evacuations to ensure orderly conduct and safety.

Bachelors degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, or a related field preferred.

Job Title: Senior Sales Manager Steel Industry
Location: Bhubaneswar, Jamshedpur, Mumbai, Bangalore
Industry: Steel
Experience: 7+ Years
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Sales Manager with strong experience in the steel industry to drive business growth, develop new markets, manage key accounts, and lead the sales team. The ideal candidate should have in-depth knowledge of steel products, excellent negotiation skills, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify new business opportunities, develop new customers, and expand market presence.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, dealers, and industrial clients.
Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and organizational targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements.
Manage key accounts and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and business development plans.
Identify opportunities to improve sales performance, profitability, and customer retention.



Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably in the steel industry.
At least 5 years of experience in a sales leadership or managerial role.
Strong understanding of steel products, the supply chain, and the Indian steel market.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.


Required Skills
Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

Description:
To lead and manage the Talent Acquisition and recruitment function for the assigned Eastern and North-Eastern region, covering Odisha, West Bengal, Assam and adjoining states.

The role will be responsible for ensuring timely and quality manpower deployment across the MFI business, with particular focus on branch-level and field-force recruitment, business expansion, replacement hiring, high-volume recruitment, regional talent availability, manpower planning, recruitment analytics, employee referrals, local sourcing and stakeholder management.

The position will work closely with Regional Heads, Zonal Heads, State Heads, Cluster Heads, Branch Managers and Corporate HR to ensure that the organisation has the right manpower in the right locations at the right time.

Role & responsibilities:
Branch & Field-Level Recruitment
Lead high-volume recruitment for MFI field and branch positions including:

Branch Managers
Assistant/Deputy Branch Managers
Credit Officers
Loan Officers
Field Officers
Collection/Recovery roles
Sales and Business Development roles
Cluster/Area/Regional-level positions
Drive recruitment for both new manpower requirements and attrition/replacement vacancies.
Establish location-wise talent pools for critical and difficult-to-fill branches.
Ensure timely deployment of manpower against approved vacancies.
Monitor vacancy ageing and take corrective action for positions remaining open beyond agreed SLAs.
Develop a branch-wise and district-wise candidate pipeline for recurring requirements.
Identify alternative sourcing channels for locations where conventional recruitment channels are ineffective.
Work closely with Regional/Zonal/State Heads to understand manpower requirements.
Analyse approved manpower against actual deployment at state, district, cluster and branch level.

Attrition & Replacement Hiring
Closely monitor field-force attrition and its impact on branch manpower.
Analyse state-wise, district-wise, cluster-wise and branch-wise attrition trends.
Identify positions requiring proactive replacement hiring.
Work with business leaders to understand the key recruitment and retention challenges in high-attrition locations.
Develop talent pools for positions with historically high turnover.
Track recruitment against attrition and ensure business continuity
Recruitment Analytics & MIS
Develop and maintain comprehensive regional recruitment dashboards and MIS.
Provide regular recruitment updates and actionable insights to senior management.
Use MS Excel extensively and leverage Power BI for recruitment dashboards and analytics.
Identify trends and recommend interventions based on recruitment data.

Employee Referral & Recruitment Initiatives
Strengthen the employee referral programme for branch and field recruitment.
Develop state-specific recruitment campaigns for difficult-to-fill locations.
Conduct recruitment drives, walk-in interviews and local hiring campaigns wherever required.
Encourage existing employees and business teams to support local talent sourcing.
Build a sustainable referral and local sourcing ecosystem across the region.
Compliance & Recruitment Governance
Ensure recruitment activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and approved manpower plans.
Ensure appropriate background verification, MFIN checks and other pre-employment verification processes.
Maintain proper recruitment records and documentation.
Ensure adherence to recruitment approval processes and defined SLAs.
Coordinate with HR Operations, Compliance and other stakeholders on recruitment-related matters.

Preferred candidate profile:
Educational Qualification
MBA/PGDM in Human Resources / Personnel Management from a recognised institution.
Full-time qualification preferred.

Experience
8 to 12 years of relevant experience in HR/Talent Acquisition within Microfinance/ MFI.
Strong hands-on experience in MFI branch and field-force recruitment is preferred.
Experience managing high-volume recruitment across multiple states/geographies.
Experience in managing recruitment teams and multiple recruitment channels.
Candidates with experience covering Odisha, West Bengal, Assam or adjoining Eastern/North-Eastern markets will be preferred.
Strong understanding of MFI business roles, branch structure, field operations and manpower requirements is mandatory.
