Description:
About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Expert, AVP
Location: Bangalore, India
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Role Description
About Human Resources
As a team, we partner with the business to drive an inclusive and sustainable performance culture. We take fair and transparent people decisions that are in the banks best interest. Team / People leadership

Job Discription
. Execute, and monitor civil construction activities for retail projects including stores, malls, and warehouses

Competencies
Strong execution and delivery-focused mindset
Ability to manage multiple retail sites simultaneously
Problem-solving and decision-making capability on site.
Effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Commitment to quality, safety, and timelines.

Description:
Job Summary
Endo Mechanical and Intelligent Devices (EMID) offers a comprehensive portfolio of surgical technologies, including open and laparoscopic stapling systems, ligation devices, access and hand instruments, powered stapling platforms, and intelligent surgical solutions. The team partners with surgeons, operating theatre staff, and healthcare institutions to support the adoption of advanced surgical technologies and improve procedural outcomes.
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding product adoption, and managing customer relationships for the Endo Mechanical and Intelligent Devices portfolio within assigned government hospital accounts across Jaipur, Bikaner Ajmer territory. The role combines territory business management, clinical support, account development, and engagement with key healthcare stakeholders to achieve commercial and strategic objectives. This role is based in Jaipur, India, supporting government and public healthcare accounts across Jaipur, Bikaner Ajmer. The position is field-based and requires regular travel within the city to support customer engagement, operating theatre coverage, product evaluations, training, and account development activities.


Responsibilities
Achieve territory sales objectives by driving product utilisation, secondary sales growth, and focus product performance across assigned government hospital accounts.
Develop and execute account plans for priority customers to increase market penetration and expand portfolio adoption.
Build and maintain relationships with surgeons, operating theatre personnel, procurement teams, and hospital decision-makers.
Provide clinical support in operating theatres, including product demonstrations, evaluations, and procedural assistance as required.
Collect, analyse, and utilise market, procedure, customer, and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities and support territory planning.
Establish and maintain professional relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), medical associations, and Centres of Excellence (COEs) within the territory.
Partner with regional and marketing teams to organise Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes and approved customer engagement initiatives.
Maintain accurate and timely reporting of sales activities, forecasts, account updates, and required business trackers.


Required Knowledge and Experience
High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6+ years experience
OR Associate s Degree AND 4+ years experience
OR Bachelor s Degree AND 2+ years experience


Preferred
Experience selling surgical stapling technologies or other advanced surgical / MedTech devices.
Experience managing government private hospital accounts of Rajasthan Medical corporation and public healthcare procurement processes.
Knowledge of surgical procedures, operating theatre workflows, and clinical decision-making environments.
Experience establishing relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), medical associations, and Centres of Excellence (COEs).
Strong analytical skills with experience using market and customer insights to develop territory growth strategies.

Description:
Incumbent as Factory Quality Head will be responsible for Managing Quality across Suppliers / Products/Processes/ Customers (Internal & External). Will be responsible for preparing Quality Assurance Strategy for ensuring right quality enablers for Supplier / Manufacturing value chain for continuous improvement of Overall Quality Metrics. This will be driven through sustainable quality systems including applicable regulatory compliances.
Key Deliverables
Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), Call Rate & Return Reduction, Flawless New Launches of Outgoing Products, QMS, Radar Score Enhancement, Quality Improvement Roadmap by Enhancing Quality Maturity Progression Score, Radar Score, Tier 2 Supplier PPM Reduction, Rolling Throughput Yield Improvement, Competency Building of team through trainings.
Duties and responsibilities
a) Integrate with various functions to formulate New Product Introduction Gate wise quality deliverables through Quality Risk Assessment sign off, tracker & objective targets. Reviewing and ensuring compliance to validation as per standards and set objectives at respective Gates. b) Ensure supplier engagement on PPAP, run@rate delivery. Execute APQP on bought out parts. c) Establish process controls, Quality systems, and critical touch points. Review performance of new products for 6 months since launch. Ensure Flawless Launch and Early Care of new product. d) Drive Built in Quality through identification on Critical stations/parameter and deploying preventive product/process controls for these parameters. e) Ensure Touch & Feel of product at par with Global standards. f)  Set a culture of shop engagement through Plan-Do-Check-Act, Problem Countermeasure Monitoring, Process Stage wise improvement tracking and Quality Circles g) Risk mitigation through Change Management / validation. h) Quality Command Centers for Top-bottom, bottom-top communication. Continuous connect to customer / dealers.
i) Upgrade Measurement system, online data acquisition, error proofing across suppliers.
j) Support chronic / sporadic problem resolution and set up immediate containment to Protect the Customer.
k) Raise Quality flag. Authorize deviation change request with support of Engineering
l) Support levelled escalations system
m) Assess various suppliers through radar mechanism width and depth of deployment of various initiatives.
n) Skill map / certifications of all factory quality professional
o)  People Development
Qualifications
BE /B.Tech with 14+ years’ experience.
Additional knowledge of QMS, IMS, Change Management,  Six Sigma, Shanin, DOE will be preferred

Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are looking for enthusiastic and result-oriented MBA freshers from the 2025 and 2026 batches to join our team as Collection Manager Management Trainees. The selected candidates will be responsible for supporting collection operations for unsecured personal loans, monitoring overdue accounts, coordinating with customers for timely repayments, and ensuring collection targets are achieved while maintaining professional customer relationships.
This role offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in retail lending, credit operations, and collections management.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor overdue accounts and follow up with customers for repayment of unsecured personal loans.
Contact customers through calls and other approved communication channels to remind them of pending payments.
Understand customer payment issues and coordinate with them to facilitate timely repayment.
Support collection teams in achieving monthly recovery targets and reducing delinquency.
Track overdue accounts, payment commitments, and collection performance.
Analyze collection reports and identify accounts requiring priority follow-up.
Coordinate with field collection executives, team leaders, and internal departments for effective recovery.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, payment commitments, and collection activities.
Ensure all collection activities comply with company policies, applicable RBI guidelines, and fair practices.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly collection performance reports for management review.
Eligibility Criteria
MBA / PGDM graduates from the 2025 or 2026 batch.
Freshers with a specialization in Finance, Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields are preferred.
Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.
Willingness to work in a target-driven environment.
Ability to handle customer interactions professionally and work effectively in a team.
Required Skills
Communication and negotiation skills
Customer relationship management
Analytical and decision-making skills
Target orientation and result focus
Time management and teamwork
Basic financial and numerical understanding

Job Title: Quantity Surveyor (EPC Projects)
Role Summary
The Quantity Surveyor is responsible for managing all cost-related aspects of EPC projects, from estimation and budgeting to contract administration and cost control. The role ensures that projects are completed within the approved budget while maintaining compliance with contractual and commercial requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cost Estimation & Budgeting
Prepare detailed cost estimates and BOQs (Bill of Quantities) based on drawings and specifications.
Support project budgeting and validate cost assumptions.
Conduct rate analysis for materials, labor, and equipment.
2. Quantity Take-offs & Measurement
Perform accurate quantity take-offs from drawings.
Verify quantities executed at site and certify measurements.
Maintain measurement records and reconciliation with BOQ.
3. Cost Control & Monitoring
Track project costs vs. budget and analyze variances.
Provide regular updates on cost performance and highlight risks.
Assist in implementing cost control measures to prevent overruns.
4. Contract & Commercial Management
Review and administer contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders.
Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions.
Manage variations, change orders, and claims (both client and subcontractor).
5. Billing & Payment Certification
Prepare and verify client invoices (RA bills) based on work progress.
Assess and certify subcontractor/vendor bills.
Ensure alignment of billing with contractual milestones and site progress.
6. Procurement Support
Assist procurement team with tender evaluation and vendor selection.
Provide cost inputs and benchmarking for procurement decisions.
7. Cash Flow & Financial Coordination
Support project cash flow planning by tracking inflows and outflows.
Coordinate with finance for invoicing, payments, and financial reporting.
8. Reporting & Documentation
Prepare periodic reports including:
Cost reports
Quantity reconciliation statements
Variation and claims status
Maintain proper documentation for audits and contractual compliance.
9. Stakeholder Coordination
Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Finance, and Procurement teams.
Act as a key commercial interface between site and corporate teams.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of quantity surveying principles and BOQ preparation
Expertise in cost estimation, rate analysis, and contract management
Familiarity with EPC contracts (FIDIC or similar frameworks)
Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and estimation software
Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
Attention to detail and commercial acumen
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering / Quantity Surveying / Construction Management
5–10 years of experience in EPC, infrastructure, or construction projects

Description:
Job Title: Manager - Training
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


The Manager - Training at Axis Max Life Insurance will be responsible for developing and implementing effective training programs for staff across various departments. This role involves assessing training needs, creating instructional materials, and delivering training sessions to enhance employee skills and knowledge. The Manager will collaborate with leadership to ensure alignment of training initiatives with company goals and will evaluate the effectiveness of training programs to drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop training programs that address identified skill gaps and enhance employee performance.
- Conduct training needs assessments and work closely with department heads to tailor training initiatives.
- Facilitate training sessions using a variety of teaching methods such as presentations, workshops, and e-learning.
- Monitor and evaluate training program effectiveness through feedback and assessments.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and best practices in training and development.
- Coordinate with external training vendors and manage relationships to optimize resources.
- Prepare training manuals, guides, and other instructional materials.
- Prepare reports on training activities and present findings to senior management.

# Job Description (JD) CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
### Stainless Steel Fabrication / Sheet Metal Manufacturing Industry

**Job Title:** CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
**Department:** Engineering, Fabrication & Operations
**Location:** [Location]
**Reporting To:** Operations Manager / Production Manager

---

## Job Summary

The CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator is responsible for developing CNC programs for laser cutting, punching, and bending machines while coordinating daily production activities across design, stores, fabrication, machining, and dispatch departments. The role ensures efficient machine utilization, material optimization, production scheduling, and on-time project execution.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### CNC Programming

- Create CNC programs for Laser Cutting, CNC Punching, and CNC Press Brake machines.
- Prepare nesting layouts to maximize sheet utilization and reduce scrap.
- Generate machine programs from CAD drawings and engineering designs.
- Optimize cutting paths and machine cycle times.
- Verify programs before production release.
- Maintain CNC program libraries and revision records.
- Support operators during program setup and troubleshooting.

### Technical & Engineering Support

- Interpret fabrication drawings, CAD files, and customer specifications.
- Coordinate with design engineers to resolve technical issues.
- Prepare production drawings and job files.
- Ensure manufacturability of designs before production release.
- Support design modifications and engineering changes.

### Operations Coordination

- Coordinate daily production schedules with fabrication and machining teams.
- Monitor work orders and production progress.
- Ensure timely availability of materials, tools, and programs.
- Coordinate between Stores, Production, Quality, and Dispatch.
- Track and expedite priority jobs to meet delivery commitments.
- Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

### Production Planning & Monitoring

- Prepare daily and weekly production plans.
- Track machine loading and capacity utilization.
- Monitor production output against targets.
- Generate production status reports for management.
- Ensure adherence to delivery schedules.

### Material Optimization

- Optimize sheet utilization through efficient nesting.
- Minimize raw material wastage and scrap generation.
- Review cutting plans for cost effectiveness.
- Coordinate material requirements with stores and purchase departments.

### Quality Control Support

- Ensure programmed dimensions conform to approved drawings.
- Support first article inspection (FAI).
- Assist in resolving dimensional and fabrication issues.
- Coordinate corrective actions for production non-conformities.

### ERP & Documentation

- Update production data in ERP systems.
- Maintain CNC program records and revision control.
- Generate production reports and machine utilization reports.
- Maintain job tracking sheets and production schedules.

### Safety & Compliance

- Follow company safety procedures and machine operating standards.
- Support implementation of 5S and lean manufacturing initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with quality management systems and SOPs.

---

## Educational Qualification

- Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
- Certification in CNC Programming, CAD/CAM, or Nesting Software preferred.

---

## Experience

### Junior CNC Programmer
- 2-4 years experience

### CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
- 4-8 years experience in sheet metal fabrication and CNC programming

### Preferred Industry Experience
- Stainless Steel Fabrication
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Electrical Enclosure Manufacturing
- Pharma Equipment Manufacturing
- Food Processing Equipment Manufacturing
- Industrial Fabrication

---

## Technical Skills

### Software
- AutoCAD
- SolidWorks
- SigmaNEST
- TruTops
- Metalix
- RADAN
- NC Express
- ERP Software
- Microsoft Excel

### Machinery
- Laser Cutting Machines
- CNC Punching Machines
- CNC Press Brake Machines
- Bending Tools & Die Selection

### Technical Knowledge
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Nesting Optimization
- Fabrication Drawings
- Production Planning
- Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
- Quality Control Processes

---

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

| KPI | Target |
|------|---------|
| Production Schedule Adherence | 95% |
| Sheet Utilization Efficiency | 95% |
| CNC Program Accuracy | 98% |
| On-Time Job Release | 95% |
| Machine Utilization | 85% |
| Rework Due to Programming Errors | 1% |
| Delivery Schedule Compliance | 95% |
| ERP/Data Accuracy | 99% |

---

## Key Deliverables

- Error-free CNC programs.
- Maximum sheet utilization and reduced scrap.
- Timely release of jobs to production.
- Smooth coordination between departments.
- High machine productivity and on-time delivery.
- Accurate production tracking and reporting.

## Career Progression

**CNC Operator CNC Programmer CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator Team Lead Operations Operations Manager Plant Manager**

This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.

Duties and Responsibilities


The role of the Credit Manager will require a strong understanding of industry knowledge market intelligence and underwriting processes at BFL to ensure that only credit worthy firms Individuals are extended loans in line with BFLs risk policies.

BFL is currently in the process of scaling up its new car business and the incumbent for this role is expected to bring in industry level insights from credit, risk as well as process perspective.

1. FTL 2 New Car loans

Monthly disbursements are expected to cross INR 100 Cr in these businesses by September 2018.

This role reports to the Regional Credit Manager.

This role covers pan India strategy for new car loans from sale purchase, balance transfer as well as re-finance perspective.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Underwriting of new car loans business
2. Incorporate industry best practices with respect to processing turn-around, risk metrics and policy
3. To provide an inside perspective on under-writing as managed by the leading financiers in the industry
4. Drive ownership of internal processes compliance with underwriting policies
5. Support Business, Risk Operations in meeting the long term goals of the respective businesses




"1.Chartered Accountant / MBA with atleast 3 years of experience in financial services under-writing
2.Atleast 3 years under-writing experience in used car loans with a reputed bank/NBFC


Skills
1. High process orientation
2. Good analytical skills
3. Positive attitude.
4. Good communication skills, with proficiency in English.
5. Ability to interact and build common ground with various stake-holders in the business"

Hands-on experience in From any of this form FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .

NOTE = 0 Days Notice or 1 Month Notice period
The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
Your Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the clients operating model.
Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controlsincluding maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have
4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–6 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

13.  Should be handling a team size of around 8-12 store employees along with restoring and
shifts including security and maintenance staff.
14. Responsible for staff retention, training and hygiene.
15. Responsible for overall performance metrics of the store like number of orders delivered,
Arrival to pick up time, stock availability, etc,
16. Should be well versed with retail store operations management.
17. Good Communication Skills- written and verbal, Technical skills required like using necessary
software for in-warding, billing, pulling reports, etc.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon.

Job Summary Consultant-Oracle with HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), and HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) experience, responsible for delivering functional solutions and support across Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and related workforce scheduling processes.
Candidate must have relevant experience of 5 to 9 Years.

Qualifications and Skills
Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Hands-on functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional).
Practical experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), including writing, testing, and troubleshooting formulas.- Functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) or similar workforce scheduling tools.
Familiarity with end-to-end HCM processes, including core HR, absence, and payroll interactions with Time and Labor.
Ability to document requirements, configurations, and test scenarios clearly and concisely.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate business requirements into Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations.

Key Responsibilities
Work as a functional Consultant-Oracle for HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), ensuring accurate time capture, approvals, and integrations with payroll and absence management.
Configure, validate, and optimize HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional) to support complex business rules, calculations, and eligibility criteria across HCM modules.
Implement and support HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) to manage workforce scheduling, shift planning, and resource allocation.- Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, map them to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud capabilities, and design functional solutions for Time and Labor and workforce scheduling.
Perform end-to-end functional testing for OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS configurations, including regression testing for new releases and patches.
Support production incidents and service requests related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor, Fast Formula, and workforce scheduling, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, and user guides for Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud modules in scope.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions for HR, payroll, and operations teams on OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS functionalities.
Coordinate with technical teams for integrations, reports, and extensions related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and scheduling solutions.
Ensure adherence to best practices, governance, and compliance requirements in all Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations and deployments.

Other Capabilities
Strong understanding of Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor processes, including time entry, approval workflows, and time valuation rules.
Ability to interpret and design complex Fast Formulas to support business-specific rules and calculations.
Experience working with workforce scheduling concepts such as shifts, rosters, rotation patterns, and resource optimization in Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler).- Good stakeholder management and communication skills to work with HR, payroll, operations, and IT teams.
Capability to work in a consulting environment, managing multiple assignments and priorities with minimal supervision.
Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail in configuration and testing activities.

Contractual Role - 1.5-3 months

Open job locations - Pune/Noida/Kolkata

B.com is mandatory

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the role requires the incumbent to proactively develop relationships with the global EY teams serving these engagements and supervise the delivery of GDS engagement management support activities.

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates with experience in carrying out routine substantive and controls-based assurance testing for the engagement teams during the financial year end for the Europe or US region.

Your key responsibilities
Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific review procedures as defined by the engagement teams
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential review issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the immediate supervisor
Collaborate with seniors and engagement teams to set goals and responsibilities
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the team members
Maintain a strong client focus, be responsive to team requests, and develop/maintain productive working relationships with team contacts
Where appropriate, challenge procedures used in the past by team members and attempt to enhance review techniques
Compare efficiency of review procedures performed across different clients and suggest ideas for improvement.
Contribute ideas/opinions to the assurance teams and listen/respond to other team members' views
Use technology to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery
Promote EYs ethical and professional standards, including data confidentiality, especially when dealing with outsiders

Skills and attributes for success
Confident and outgoing individual with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to meet tight deadlines and ensure that work is of a consistently high standard
Ability to multi-task, pay attention to detail, prioritize projects and follow up on routine tasks diligently
Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping,
Ability to communicate with leaders and peers with ease
Plan ahead and anticipate potential issues before they arise
Good written and oral communication skills
Ability to work effectively in a team

To qualify for the role, you must have
Candidates with CA Completed / CA Inter with Articleship completed
6 months to 1 year of relevant work experience preferred.

Ideally, youll also have
Interest in business and commerciality.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: Youll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Well provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Well give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Youll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS CONSULTING SAP BASIS SENIOR

At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity
As a Senior SAP BASIS Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This senior role offers you the opportunity to ensure system stability, security, and high performance across complex SAP landscapes.
You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Performance monitoring & tuning, Problem analysis & resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX & Windows
System /System copy
ABAP + Java-dual stack
Add-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
Kernel Upgrade
Client copies and export-import
TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
SAP Role based Authorization knowledge - Role creation and modification
Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
OSS Note application
Experience in Single -Sign On, Web Dispatcher
Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
Hands-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.
Skills and attributes for success
Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
Solid hands-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and auditready technical documentation.
Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.

Description:
Service line - Position Title: FAAS MS Manager Financial reporting
At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The Opportunity
We’re looking for incumbents who is responsible for the timeliness and quality of the work as per Project requirements for our FAAS team and possess strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge. The role requires prior experience and knowledge of financial reporting activities.

Your Key Responsibilities
Managing engagement delivery Financial Accounting and Reporting and GAAP conversions.
Providing advice and assisting client team in accounting change (First time IFRS adoption, revenue recognition, lease accounting), accounting policy manuals and technical accounting memorandums
Identify and develop business opportunities; manage accounts
Leading a team of 7-10 team members including engagement PMO activities
Maintain effective coordination with multiple stakeholders. Be compatible with business accounting teams and internal partners to resolve issues
Coach junior team members, encourage technical excellence and learning
Detailed review of the work performed by the team members
Integrate with other EY service lines on multi-disciplinary projects
Developing and delivering accounting technical trainings
Ensure quality in delivering client service by directing daily progress of fieldwork, informing Supervisors of engagement status
Engaged in hiring of team members, structured learning path and operations mentor for the team
Demonstrate a good understanding of accounting concepts; stay informed of professional standards and firm policies (e.g., guidelines of the EY FAAS Policy Manual); and effectively apply this knowledge to moderately difficult and/or complex client situation

Skills and attributes for success
Expert knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP, UK GAAP etc
Experience in having filed 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K with SEC, or else being a part of corporate finance team of listed company and having made quarterly and annual financial filings to stock exchanges.
Extensive experience in the following areas:
Financial statement preparation and consolidation process
GAAP conversions and adoption of new accounting standards
Drafting accounting policies and writing technical memorandums
Technical accounting advisory on complex topics (e.g. financial instruments, deferred tax, business combinations, consolidation, debt/equity etc.)
Ability to explain & manage complex accounting and financial reporting issues

To qualify for the role, you must have
CA, ACCA (UK), or CPA
5+ years relevant experience

Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good

In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have

Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations

Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Overview
AtkinsR alis is one of the world s leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. Your role
Authoring technical ecological reports.
Analysing bat sound data.
As a proficient user of GIS, supporting with desk studies, scoping sites, records of protected species and biodiversity net gain assessments.

Being a team player and delivering responsibilities by meeting deadlines.
Developing your technical skills through Continuing Professional Development.
Managing your own time and workload in collaboration with other team members.

2-4 years of experience working on ecology projects with experience in the UK region preferred.
Experience in Anabat Insight/ Kaleidoscope.
Proficient GIS skills (QGIS/ArcGIS).
Working knowledge of UKHab classification and the Defra Metric will be preferred.
Proficient ability to interpret, review and analyse data to produce reports.
Understanding of UK and EU Wildlife Legislation, planning policies, and licensing requirements.
Previous experience of working in international projects.
Project management experience including technical, financial and quality assurance aspects.
Membership of the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM).
Highly motivated and proactive, focused on achieving and delivering technical excellence.

Quick to learn and adapt on the job.

Open to discussing career goals and aspirations.

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive at every stage of your life and your career.

Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Role & responsibilities

We are hiring a Lead Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience to build and own backend services in Java and Spring Boot while guiding the junior engineers. This is a hands-on role: you will write production code every week, and you will also set technical direction, review the team's work and lead delivery of features from design to release.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on development
Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
Build search and indexing features on Elasticsearch, and model and tune data in MongoDB.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and own features end to end, from requirement to production.

Proven experience designing and building microservices: REST APIs, service communication, resilience and fault tolerance.
Working experience with Elasticsearch: index design, queries, mappings and performance tuning.
Working experience with MongoDB: schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines and query optimization.
Good understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns and clean-code principles.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and ownership; able to explain technical choices clearly to team members and stakeholders.

Good to Have
Experience with Kafka or another messaging or event-streaming platform.
Experience with MySQL or other relational databases, including SQL tuning.
Knowledge of Angular, to work with front-end teams and review integrations.
Background in a product-based company (strongly preferred).
Team management experience, such as leading, mentoring, or coordinating a small team (a big plus).
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), and monitoring tools.

Education: B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science or a related field) or MCA.

What you will get
Ownership of real, business-critical systems and a say in how they are designed.
A clear leadership path: you will lead a team and grow with it.
Exposure to a modern stack and large-scale, high-volume data and search problems.
A collaborative engineering culture with room to learn and grow.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 8–12 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
Role- Individual Contributor
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.

Job Description
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.
Your role
Key Responsibilities:
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks, Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking
Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Microstation (add on)
BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)
Required Skills Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
About you
Qualification
Graduate Engineers (Bachelor's degree) with up to 3 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record
Desirable Experience
Canada infrastructure or consultancy project experience
Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows

Description:
Area

Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities
Product Costing

Prepare and maintain standard cost estimates in SAP S/4 HANA.
• Prepare product cost sheets and conversion cost calculations.
• Support costing for new product introductions and technology transfers.
• Analyze cost variances and product profitability.
US Product Costing & COGS

Prepare COGS for US market products.
• Develop cost sheets for Baddi, Topical and Viona products.
• Support budget cycle costing for regulated market products.
• Monitor product profitability and margins.
Plant Accounting

Manage plant costing and accounting activities.
• Review daily production reports and utility consumption.
• Monitor manufacturing cost trends and cost variances.
• Support monthly financial closing activities.
MIS & Financial Reporting

Prepare monthly MIS and Finance Dashboard.
• Analyze P&L performance, yield variances and manpower productivity.
• Present key financial highlights and improvement opportunities.
• Support management reviews through financial analytics.
Budgeting & Forecasting

Prepare annual OPEX budgets and monthly forecasts.
• Conduct budget versus actual analysis.
• Support site cost control initiatives.
• Monitor spending against approved budgets.
Inventory & Asset Management

Support inventory valuation and inventory controls.
• Conduct monthly physical verification of SFG and open production orders.
• Support fixed asset verification and cleansing activities.
• Monitor working capital related inventory performance.
Cost Audit & Compliance

Coordinate cost audit activities and documentation.
• Prepare cost audit data and statutory costing reports.
• Maintain costing records and audit compliance.
• Support internal and external audit requirements.
SAP Costing & Absorption

Execute monthly SAP absorption runs.
• Release standard costs in SAP S/4 HANA.
• Monitor cost center allocations and absorption accuracy.
• Ensure integrity of costing master data.
Cost Improvement Initiatives

Validate SLIM and productivity projects.
• Support savings tracking and realization.
• Generate cost optimization opportunities.
• Support operational excellence initiatives from a finance perspective.
CAPEX Evaluation

Conduct financial evaluation of CAPEX proposals.
• Track post-implementation benefits and ROI.
• Support capital investment decision-making.
AboutCompany:
Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.
